title: Otori Emu — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gym class is next! Wahohoy♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hehe, Emu's always so perky.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. It must be nice to not have to worry about anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But is it possible for someone to no worries at all?)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Okay, see you tomorrow!
You're going for your part-time job now, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Have fun with club activities, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You have fun too. Bye!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I will. See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is she looking outside? But she seems a little sad...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Honami! What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry for interrupting your thoughts.
I was just wondering why you were still here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I mean, you would usually dash out of the classroom immediately after homeroom, right? But you're still here today, so I couldn't help but wonder...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! That's exactly it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly...what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I could hardly wait and was just about to KABOOM my way out, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today's inspection day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Inspection day? Oh, right!
You're working in Phoenix Wonderland as one of the cast members, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup♪
I perform on stage every day after school!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I had to take today off because the park is closed for inspection... Even though the inspection's only for the attractions and not the stages...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. That's a real shame...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You really love performing on stage, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! I do!
And you know, our show is really, really cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Robo-Nene goes, Lalala, as it sings and the mascots go, Graaar! as fearsome dragons!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Robo-Nene? Mascot dragons?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! So our show's bound to make everyone smile☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, it sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That does make it very sad that you can't go today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... And also...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hm? She's looking outside again...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't like evenings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because evenings make it feel like another fun day's about to come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, is there something you're worried about?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ah, I'm trying to meddle again...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course I'm worried about stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I've made some friends lately who've been helping me out! So I'm sure it'll all work out somehow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Friends...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. They must be really nice people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They are!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, I know!
I'll go look for them now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come with me, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I'm really happy to be invited along, but I have work today, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww. It can't be helped, then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In that case, come watch our show one of these days! I'll introduce you to my friends!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Promise me you will! Pinky promise!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I will. Pinky promise.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll see you tomorrow then, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... I'll definitely go watch your show, Emu.
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We still have some time before the live show starts. Wanna drop by Ken's place for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey hey hey! You guys over there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa?! Wh-What the?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's a guy in this school who goes Hahahaha! and strikes weird poses out of nowhere, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? We don't have someone so crazy in thi—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you referring to Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes, that's him!
Do you know what class he's in?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's in 2-A. Go up those stairs there and turn right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay, thanks! Handshake thanks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye then♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wh-What was that all about? And she's clearly not a student of this school. Why'd you tell her where the classroom was?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She knows Tsukasa, so it'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On the contrary... That's even worse.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I have nothing but bad feelings about this.
Hey, let's just head over to Ken's before we get dragged into anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui's talking to him about something...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I can't hear what they're saying.
If only I had Robo-Nene with me...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... 2-A, 2-A... Where's 2-A?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-Why is Emu here?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm? That girl just now really looked like Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know! She must be a look-alike!
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah! Found classroom 2-A☆
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hi, Tsukasa! So we're going to discuss our plans for the stage production in this classroom?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. There's no one else around at the moment so it's the perfect spot, really. We have plenty of things to do even on inspection day! Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sideways wonderhoy assault!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You?! What're you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I found Tsukasa and Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, if it isn't Emu! Welcome to our school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you welcoming her like this is perfectly normal?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In the first place, Emu! You're not even a student of this—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Is someone there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh! Rui, hide Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa-whee?!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, it's you two. Some students outside said they heard the strange squealing of someone from another school just now. Do you guys know anything about that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-No, sir! We didn't see anything!
Absolutely nothing at all!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Really? Well if you do see anything, let me know.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, was he talking about me just now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Who else could it be?! This is really bad.
We need to get you out before you're—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, by the way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, sir?!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Go home soon if you have nothing to do here, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes! We're going! We're going right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... I almost had a heart attack...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are you okay? You look so tired.
Do you wanna hear me sing a happy song?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... Why take the trouble to come all the way here anyway?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I'm the only one in a different school, the stage is closed so we can't practice today, and it's no fair that I don't get to meet everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She has a point.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should find a place where we can still meet together even on days with no practice sessions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That would allow us to discuss things like the script and practice menu together at any time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Fantastic idea, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm honored by your compliment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I guess we could go to a nearby diner for today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! Let's go to that diner, like right now♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey! Don't just step out without checking first!
What if the teachers see you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I can't help myself because I'm so happy♪
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, are you trying to give me a heart attack? What are you doing here anyway?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! I dropped in to see you♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can't just sneak into people's schools whenever you want to see them! So, what do you want?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, I brought you these!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seriously, you dumped a pile of photos on my desk?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on... Are these from our shows?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, the mascots took them!
They're pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Point out ONE that's good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do you mean? You don't like them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! None of them shows ME being awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm out of the frame in every picture. They're all focused on you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But look at this one!
They caught you mid-blink. You look so dopey, haha♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you even listening?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I am! But why are you so angry?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because there are no good pictures here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's not true! They're very good, every one of them! Look at this one for example!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Robo-Nene's doing her razzle dazzle thing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And this picture's so aaah but also yee-haw whoa hoy hoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't understand what aaah yee-haw whoa hoy hoy is supposed to mean...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this is a decent photo, I give you that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Told you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your park mascots know how to capture photogenic moments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Urgh, what am I saying!?
They didn't photograph me at all!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Found it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're ignoring me again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See this girl? She looks familiar, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where? You mean this blurry person in the audience?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Lately, she's been coming to our shows every week!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Was there someone like that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How can you not remember the hammie girl who's always sitting in the same seat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hammie? What is that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You really don't know what I'm talking about? Her cheeks go poof-poof like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Her cheeks...go poof-poof?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It's totally poof-poof but, at the end, she always explodes into a smile♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry, I have no idea who that is.
But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If she's showing up every week, she could be our most devoted fan.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's big news, right?
I've got to tell Nene and Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll go show them the photos!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait up, Emu! You forgot some!
Come back and pick them all up, you hear?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee♪ Ruiii♪
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: When is the show starting?

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: I'm so excited for it. The last one was really funny!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Why's it taking so long?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see if she's in her usual seat...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes, there she is!
The poofy-cheek hammie girl!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that girl sitting on the right?
I do actually remember seeing her!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm. Indeed, I've seen her too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. She comes all the time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So you noticed her too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's hard not to. She's always watching us with this...intensity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She reacts to everything so vividly, the emotions clearly expressed on her face.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, well. That's great, it means she's enjoying every moment of our shows!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that I think of it, the few times she didn't seem thrilled, our shows received a lukewarm reaction from the rest of the audience, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means it's not the case of her being easily impressed, but of not disguising her true emotions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She keeps coming to see our shows even though they can be hit or miss with her...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh, we've gotten ourselves a loyal fan.
That's all thanks to my star power!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's so nice that she keeps wanting to see us on stage♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Say guys, shouldn't we do a ta-ta-ta-ta-daaah for her?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Prepare a surprise for her?
A splendid idea, Emu, as usual.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How did you understand what she meant?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Come on, you can figure this one out with a monkey brain.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A mind-reading monkey brain, maybe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What sort of thing could we do for her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm. Let me think...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We could feature balloon art in a part during our show.
We'd invite her to come on stage and drape our balloon art over her.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yesss! I like it. Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's got that cute hammie face, so let's make her a hammie balloon!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like I said, what the heck is a hammie?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure, Emu. I know in fact how to make hamster balloons. You twist it like this and then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh, I didn't know you could make a hamster, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh, I want to make one too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You make me feel like I'm surrounded by a bunch of little children...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh well, it's not without entertaining value, and if it's going to make our most loyal fan happy, then let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Each one of us could make a hamster balloon in a different color for her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You get my supersize elephant seal of approval♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! Mine will be golden!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait a sec, look at the time! We should be starting our performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're right! Let's begin our show with a special treat for our number one fan!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Our balloon jamboree was a success!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It wasn't so much balloon art as balloon armor towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, the girl was enjoying it so much, I couldn't stop myself from making more and more balloons.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We made her laugh so much! It made me really happy too! We should do more shows like this♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahahaha! Like this, and better!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. What would you like to show next?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... What would be fun... Oh, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A show that's 100% wonderhoy☆
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sigh... Where did that person who was performing with the robots go?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why isn't he coming again? I've been looking all over!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, why are you turning that garbage bin upside down?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm looking for the performer with the robots!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He can't possibly be hiding in a garbage bin!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really? I mean, he was so weird!
It's totally possible he would do something weird like this, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Robot guy, are you there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... Listen Emu. There's no need for you to waste time looking anymore. And that's because...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've already found him!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's awesome! How'd you find him, though?!
Are you actually a detective in disguise?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, finding a person is a breeze for someone like me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're so amazing, Tsukasa! Like Sherlock Homeless!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's Holmes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've already told him to drop by today.
We'll go get him together later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sir, yes, sir!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means we have to get ready for a grand reception!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grand reception?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everybody, gather around!
Okay, so I want you to do this, and then that, and then mumbo jumbo...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: *nods*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, what are you telling the mascots to do?
Let me in on it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, can you stand over there for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Over here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: *nods*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
O-Okay?
Do what exactly?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready... GO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Th-The mascots just launched her into the air...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why's she falling straight down towards me—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Big Welcome Cannon!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: AAAAAAaaaAaaAAaAAAHhhhHH!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oomph!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa, that was a beautiful landing... Like it matters! You would've crashed straight into me if I hadn't moved out of the way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Were you trying to kill me or something?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I like to use Big Welcome Cannon to give someone a grand reception!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe, what did you think? Was it impactful enough?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no need for a welcoming greeting to have that much impact! Do something more normal!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why?! I just wanted to drive home the point that he's very welcome here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's such an intense point that you'll be driving him away instead! After all the trouble I went through to get him to even show up in the first place!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Will that happen?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen. First impressions last forever!
If you're really serious about gathering people, use your head more!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Think about how to welcome newcomers in a courteous way that will leave a good impression on them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I didn't know you were taking this so seriously!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Well, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since I've already agreed to do this, you can expect me to put in my best effort! That's what a true star would do!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe... I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's think of a proper way to welcome him together then!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We haven't visited Miku in such a long time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We've been too busy making preparations for our own performances lately to drop by.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But they've helped us out a lot, so it's only right that we update them properly on what's been happening lately!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wonder how everyone's doing?
And where are they, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Probably near the stage?
Let's go look for...hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku Costume
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! It's a Miku mascot costume!
And it's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That costume... Miku, you're inside, right?
You scared me the other day, but I won't fall for the same antic twice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Take off that costume and come on out, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm over here☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nowaaargh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, wow! Hi, Miku! Huh?
Then who's in the mascot costume?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe, sorry for the scare.
It was me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You should never disappoint your guests by surprising them with the same trick twice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's KAITO!
Hi, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello. It's been a while, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh, I can't believe I fell for it hook, line, and sinker...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's good to see you again after so long, Miku, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, same here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Long time no see, Miku!
Okay, so, the four of us have been performing on stage together after that day!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice!

rows.Speaker: Emu

Do you wanna join us?

rows.Line: Hey, don't just dub over me like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good gracious...
Well, if we're doing this, we might as well ask Rui and Nene to join us too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
Let's all join in the fun together☆
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Line: Hum hum huuum, hu-hu-hum♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're in a pretty good mood, Emu.

rows.Line: Yeap! Because Tsukasa and Rui have made up and our next show looks like it's gonna be super fun and exciting too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Haha, yeah.

rows.Line: Panda?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Where could Tsukasa have gone to?

rows.Line: Ah! Since he said he was going to cool down, maybe he's somewhere near water?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

Hi there, Mr. Panda!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah-hah! I'll ride on this panda to look for Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let me get on first... Okay, panda!
You gotta help me here♪ Here's your coin, clinkity-clink☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! It's moving!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, panda!
To Tsukasa we go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Panda's so slow, though!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ah! But I can't be impatient in times like these, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsuuukaaasaaa, wheeeere aaaare yooou?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What in the world?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You remember the time when you rode on Robo-Nene and went whooshie-whoosh to and fro? I was trying to copy that♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But unlike Robo-Nene, the Mr. Panda was reeeeeeeally slow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course it was...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I still managed to find Tsukasa and talk to him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait! While you were still on the panda?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nah, I'd already gotten off by the time I was talking to him. Oh, yeah! You should've seen how amazing the Mr. Panda was!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It came to a sudden stop the moment I found Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Almost as if it was telling me to go to him quickly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Putting aside everything that sounded wrong about what you just said because I can't even be bothered anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, how did your conversation with him go?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We came back to Wonder Stage together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't tell me...you rode the panda back together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nah. What happened was...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Now that's the classic Tsukasa-style delivery!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure he'll hear you out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll talk to him properly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, let's go back to Wonder Stage together!
Nene and Mr. Panda are probably really worried about us right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's not nice to keep Nene and Mr. Panda waiting... Wait. Who's Mr. Panda?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, here, this is Mr. Panda!
Clinkity-clink♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were talking about that panda car?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why would it be worried about me?!
And more importantly, did you ride this panda all the way here looking for me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For goodness' sake, I have so many questions I don't even know where to start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! Tsukasa's back to being Tsukasa again, yay♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't you yay♪ me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So that fancy music slowly losing steam coming from behind me just now was because of this fellow, huh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Do you wanna ride together?
I think Mr. Panda's strong enough for both of us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Leave me out of this! It'll be daybreak by the time we actually get back to the stage! I'm going on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahh! Don't be so mean, Tsukasa! Wait for me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm frankly amazed things worked out the way they did.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What are you laughing about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You were worried about Tsukasa too, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, if even Tsukasa were to be in low spirits, we wouldn't be able to do the show at all, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why it was so awesome.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When Tsukasa nailed the scene that Rui came up with!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. That wall-climbing scene, right?
I'm sure both Tsukasa and Rui breathed a sigh of relief after that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And...so did we.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ And now we can keep expecting Rui to come up with even more amazing stage effects!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's our next show after Halloween going to be like? I can't wait to find out☆
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hum hum huuum, hu-hu-hum♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are we the first to arrive?
I guess it's only natural that no one would be here at such an early hour!

rows.Line: It is as you have said.

rows.Line:
Miss Emu, practice doesn't start for a while.
Why have you chosen to come so early?

rows.Line: Hehehe, because I couldn't sleep at all when thinking about what happened the last time♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: The last time?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm talking about the Halloween show, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Director! We have remarkably many visitors lining up today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh? Excellent!
Let's see what sort of demographic it is this time... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Am... Am I seeing this right?
Are these creatures...crawling out of graves?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, that was me trying to imitate Tsukasa's lines♪ Could you tell? Did I sound like him?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
Yes. You had his vocal quirks down pat.
I can almost visualize the scene that played out that day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, right♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It was such an enjoyable show, wasn't it, Miss Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone had so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Last year was fun too, but this year was so much more fun!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (Miss Emu is very kind to say that, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (Because of our inadequacies, we were unable to help her accomplish what she really wanted to do last year.)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (But this year...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This year was just full of awesome events, wasn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It started with me finding Tsukasa during his part-time job interview...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to take my first steps to stardom on one of your stages, and I shall repay you with a plethora of incredible shows the crowds will fall in love with!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did someone say incredible shows?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe☆ Found someone good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then we got everyone together to throw Tsukasa a fantastic welcoming party♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then we found Rui performing his drone puppet show! And then Tsukasa brought Rui here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then this time, Rui brought a robot along with him! And it was Nene who was controlling the robot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can still remember how exciting every single event felt♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (Miss Emu has finally managed to find the troupe members she had always been looking for.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, we did fail and fight with each other lots at first, and that made me really sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm glad I didn't give up back then!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I didn't give up, so many people are coming to this stage to watch our shows now!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. It certainly coincides with the thrill and enthusiasm felt around the stage during its prime.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonder Stage has an audience of smiling faces again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think that's why I'm always having so much fun right now. It's like I'm going on an outing every day♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... That's why...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I really hope that nothing changes, and we can keep the stage here forever.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: As of right now, all plans to knock down Wonder Stage have been suspended indefinitely.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: If Wonder Stage becomes more popular, I am certain that your family will understand where you are coming from.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now that that's decided, we have to do what we can to make sure it happens♪

rows.Line: I apologize for reporting this late. The zombie robots that were used in the Halloween show will be taking part in today's park greeting activities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ohhh, that's great!
I wonder how everyone's gonna react?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I believe a test run is being conducted before practice starts today, so some of them may be already here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gyaaah!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: That sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's Tsukasa! No fair!
He must've bumped into the zombie robots already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Great! I'm gonna go meet them now too!
Come with me, Mr. Mascot♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Of course.

Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And one last time...

rows.Line: Great job with the Sports Festival, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Emu
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Line: Aah, that hit the spot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even juice boxes taste better when you drink them in celebration♪

rows.Line: I can't say that I disagree. Let's open up our lunch boxes too and dig in.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It's time to chow down!

rows.Line: I wonder if Saki's having lunch with her old friends.

rows.Line: Probably. She was the one who invited me, so I was hoping we could have this little celebration with her too.

rows.Line:
We can just do it again when she's free!

rows.Line: Hehe, that's a good idea.

rows.Line: The Sports Festival was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everything from that day is still so fresh in my mind. Like when I passed you the baton during the relay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! It's like I just had it in my hand a second ago!

rows.Line: And! And! Running like the wind with Mafuyu was sooo awesome too!

rows.Line:
You really were amazing.

rows.Line: And when you crossed the finish line, everyone that was watching went wild!

rows.Line: Hehehe! It was a ton of fun! And best of all, everyone enjoyed the race as much as I did!

rows.Line: Rhythmic gymnastics, swimming and... What else was it...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, and dance club☆ There's just too many things I want to do, so I'm splitting my time between them all!

rows.Line: So you're good at all sports and not just running. Were you in any sports clubs outside of school?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I didn't have time for that. I was always hanging out at Phoenix Wonderland after school...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...! Maybe re-enacting all the cool shows I saw every day was good exercise?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, re-enacting every day... You went to Phoenix Wonderland every day?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! My grandpa made it! And I've been going there every day ever since I was reeeally little.

rows.Line: Oh... Come to think of it, your last name is Otori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I heard you're in a theater group there but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess that massive theme park is like your own backyard then.

rows.Line: And you were doing your own versions of the shows you saw there?

rows.Line: Yup! Phoenix Wonderland has lots of other stages too besides the Wonder Stage where I perform!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I went to see all of them and try to copy the fun bits, like acrobatics and stuff, after they were all done!

rows.Line: It was awesome! They'd go BOING and jump reeeally high into the air and do a flippy-flip before landing!

rows.Line: I wanted to learn how to do that so badly, I practiced it a bunch with Mr. Mascot...

rows.Line: Mr. Mascot?

rows.Line: Yup! He's one of Phoenix Wonderland's park mascots!

rows.Line: When I was trying to do the crazy jump with the flips and stuff, Mr. Mascot got really mad at me for doing dangerous stunts like that all by myself...

rows.Line: You're even friends with the park mascots. I'm getting jealous.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Wow, you really do!

rows.Line: I really love penguins, but I keep buying Phenny merch because he looks like one too.

rows.Line: I mean, I know it's supposed to be a phoenix instead of a penguin, but still...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's cool!
I didn't know you liked Phenny so much!

rows.Line: In that case, I have a special treat for you! Are you ready for Phoenix Wonderland's Phenomenal Phenny Trivia?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phenny Trivia?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Did you know that if you ask Phenny to fly, he'll happily flap his wings for you?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But he can't fly, so it's suuuper cute to see him flap and flap with everything he has!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phenny, flapping those tiny wings like that...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's so adorable...!
Thank you for telling me, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! No probs!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to tell Minori, Hoshino, Tenma and Airi this too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And if we went and saw it for ourselves...
It'd be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think a trip to Phoenix Wonderland is in order now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! You're welcome to visit anytime!
There are so many fun shows to see too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And don't forget to come and see me at the fantastically fun-filled Wonder Stage!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yahohoy☆
Sorry for the wait, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Starting today, I'm back to rehearsing like before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's good. I was glad to hear that your Sports Festival went well too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure your ideas turned into a great show that made everyone smile, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Of course!
Everyone was saying how much fun it was!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's great...!

rows.Line: Well, it's a show, right? That means success was your only option as a performer!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we get it... But I'm happy for you, Emu. Your hard work really paid off in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for being so late!
I'll get ready right away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Hey! Emu, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's always been a bundle of energy, but she hasn't been herself lately...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It'd be perfectly reasonable for her to skip practice on days when she has to prepare the Sports Festival...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That may be so, but both are fun things that she doesn't want to let go of...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, something tells me that taking it easy is not a concept she can understand.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm ready!
Which part were you at?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were just about to get started with a table read. And... Good, you have your script ready. Then let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
D-Did I hear that right?
You're all self-proclaimed heroes?!

rows.Speaker: Fairy
rows.Line:
What's going on?!
I can't tell who the actual hero is anymore!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Uh oh... She forgot to say,

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(And that other line was supposed to be,
I can't tell who the real hero is...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But it doesn't change things all that much.
We'll just have to roll with it...)

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: Listen! I'm the 'real' hero, and I can prove it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you ready to go home?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, did Emu seem kind of out of it today...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, she's always sort of been like that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But she doesn't usually forget or skip her lines like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. And it's not like she wanted to put her own spin on them either...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's never done that on the fly and always asks in advance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah, she slipped up because she couldn't focus...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between preparing for the Sports Festival and our rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose it means that even Emu can get worn out sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm... Speaking of which... Where is she?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu?! Where are you?!
We're all about to go home!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She was tidying up the stage props just a moment ago... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
T-There...!
That has to be her feet...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?! Did she faint...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu? Are you okay?!
Hm... Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm... Zzzz...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-She's asleep?!
Ugh... You had me worried there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She must have been more tired than she let on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, would you be okay with us changing our rehearsal schedule for the weekend show...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. We shouldn't start with the acrobatic scenes tomorrow if Emu's like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And her school's Sports Festival is in... Three days.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. If she were to get hurt during rehearsal, she wouldn't be able to participate in that either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ngh... Hm? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, you woke up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! Sorry, did I fall asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. You were sleeping like a baby, so we didn't want to wake you.

rows.Line: Anyways, we were talking about our schedule for tomorrow. The new plan is to carry out maintenance on the stage props...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, why? What happened to the stunt scenes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Your Sports Festival is in three days.
Our show is this weekend.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You should channel all of your energy into the Sports Festival for now! As for our show... We can revise the stunt scenes later!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, you want to give your best performance at the Sports Festival, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why you should focus on that. Not being able to do your best because of exhaustion would be terrible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, pinky promise! I'll make it so eeeveryone at the Sports Festival smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then let's get started...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, just one thing!
I wanted to thank you all properly!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For being so considerate towards me! I had an amazing time during the Sports Festival thanks to your kindness and support!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you sooo much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. That's what friends do for each other.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But you better be ready to practice now!
We have an audience to entertain this weekend!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's do this!
Won...won... Wonderhoy♪
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright. The story for our Christmas show is pretty much all there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
I have to get that thing ready♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Where did Emu go?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't know.
I think she ran off to get something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder what...? Oh, she's already back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the...? She's got a whole cart loaded with boxes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Phew! Okay, I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu, what's with these boxes?
And what do you have to get ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe! It's something special...
Ta-daa♪ Christmas decorations galore☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, nice!
Is that what you've got in those boxes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! The mascots and I put these up every year, but you're all invited to join in this year♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's a lot...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look, Nene! Aren't they cute?
And these come in all sorts of adorable colors!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, they are.
I don't think I've seen any like these before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If the choice is ours, we can try to find decorations that match our Christmas show's theme to give it a more festive atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good idea! Okay, let's get decorating!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene, & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's looking good, but we haven't even looked at the last two boxes Emu brought.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, these are for somewhere else♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Somewhere else?
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-When did that thing get here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well... This Christmas tree must be at least two stories tall.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, wait. This might be an artificial tree.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right! We put it up every year, and we wouldn't be able to put spinning light-up decorations on a real tree so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Decorating a tree this big is going to be a lot of work, but it's right at the entrance to our stage. It needs to stand out!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm starting to think we've bitten off more than we can chew...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why's it so difficult?
I can't get these lights in the right place!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The tree's so big, it's hard to get them in the right place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The length of the cables adds to the difficulty.
Poor Tsukasa getting tangled up and all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I almost tied myself to the tree...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, how did you decorate this tree last year?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... I was busy decorating the stage, so the mascots took care of the tree. I don't actually know how they did it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: BUUUT! I have an idea♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'll climb up to the top with the lights and twirl them off round and round!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm, okay. That might work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How did that make sense to you?!
Please explain it so normal people can understand.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, you know the twirly ribbons they use for gymnastics? I hang out at the rhythmic gymnastic club at school, so I know how to use them too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, now I think I get the idea. You'll sit on top of the tree and twirl the cord like a ribbon...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Using centrifugal force to wrap the lights around the tree. It's brilliant, but we should shorten the cord for the sake of ease and safety.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's an electrical cord. You can't just cut it with a pair of scissors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I always carry my tool kit with me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right... Of course you do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since it's a fake tree, it won't matter if the lights are wrapped around a bit tight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I can't really picture it in my head.
But it's not like we have any better ideas so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Phew, I made it to the top!
Commencing Operation Twirly Lights!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wheee!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! Even after trimming them down, the lights are still pretty long. Look at them go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But can Emu actually get them around the tree?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready...! Steady...! GO!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-How?! She's getting them all to wrap around! And look nice too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright! Here goes another one!
And... Wheee!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Look at that! This is spectacular!
I mean, she's doing a pretty decent job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha! The show must go on! Wheee!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not so she's twirling a ribbon, but more like she's whipping the tree and tying it up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, huh... But she has to hold tight or it'll end up like the way we did it earlier...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe this is a little unwholesome for kids to see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wahahaha! More! MORE!
WHEEE!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This goes with our Christmas show perfectly too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It does. All that's left to do is put on a good performance and make sure our audience has a good time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! This is gonna be amazing!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu? Hey, you there?
It's time to put the Christmas stuff away.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right. Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Putting them up wasn't easy, but taking them down might be even harder. Robo-Nene, can you help us?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep. Roger!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apparently, some people were saying that our area had the most spectacular decorations.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! I heard that from the mascots too!
Lots of people were taking pictures!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(And a lot of them saw our show too!
I'm glad so many came!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Grandpa, look!
I hung up this star!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! There's more where that came!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehehe. I had so much fun back then.
We had star ornaments, snowflakes and...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What are you doing, Emu? We're taking the decorations down, not hanging them up again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Haha. I didn't realize what I was doing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh. I get that it's sad to take these down, but Christmas is sadly over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have other cool shows coming up to celebrate New Year's too, so you still have a lot to look forward to!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All that's left is this big tree!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right. But how do we do this?
The ornaments go all the way to the top...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe Emu can climb up to the top again and throw down the less fragile ones for us to catch?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here, we can stand at the base of the tree while holding this sheet of bubble wrap. That way we won't hurt our hands.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Just like in a game. Of course you'd come up with this sort of solution.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it sounds easy enough. Emu, do you mind climbing up and tossing the ornaments back down to us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No probs!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm at the top! Now let's take this one down... And this one... And that one too... Get ready, guys♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait! Three at once?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here they come♪ Caaatch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can get this one! Can you get the other?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but the third one... Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Roger. Object intercepted.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, you did it! Amazing!
I guess that was too easy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright! Take that! And that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And another one!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seriously?! Why is she staggering when she throws them?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. She's really making it into some kind of catching game for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
There's more where that came from!
See if you can catch them all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Bring it on!
We're going for the perfect score!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehehe! Taking down decorations has never been this much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Christmas with the mascots was fun, too, but not like this...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! Yes, I got it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, don't hold back. Tsukasa will catch everything like his life depends on it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, keep aiming at Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on! You're all supposed to be helping too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Get ready, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got to meet everyone and do shows with them! And Christmas was way more fun than usual too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is the last one! Catch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... There!
As promised, I caught every single one!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good job, Tsukasa.
Thank you too, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why don't you come down now and rest up a bit?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure, I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was so much fun!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The sky looks so much closer when seen from on top of the tree.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Almost close enough to reach up...
To where Grandpa is now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Can you see me from up there, Grandpa?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu! Hurry up!
Come down so we can take a break!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay! Just give me a second!
Make some room for me to land!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Land...? Wait, you're not going to...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here goes! Wheeee!
And... Stuck the landing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh... Emu, please... You might be fine doing that, but I thought I was about to have a heart attack...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Sorry♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But how about we...
Race back to the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what about taking a break?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready, steady... Go! Hehehe!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've gotta do what I can too...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Tomorrow, we'll be meeting with Riley Entertainment to finalize a licensing agreement that will allow us to use their characters.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As I'm sure you're already aware, Riley Entertainment produces and distributes films, some of which have become blockbusters that spawned a variety of popular characters.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland will have themes centering around these characters from now on.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're out of choices.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've seen other rides get taken down or renovated to be all new but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If that partnership actually goes through, this won't be grandpa's Phoenix Wonderland anymore!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Phoenix Wonderland's a place where everyone from kids to the elderly all get to smile...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you know about this too, Mr. Mascot?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: No. This is my first time hearing this as well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's today too, right? When Riley Entertainment is supposed to come...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. That appears to be the plan...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Before they get here, I need to talk to Keisuke and Shosuke one last time.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: B-But what about practicing for your show...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll just have to say that I can't make it. Then I can go and talk to my brothers.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Please, Mr. Mascot. Will you find where they are for me?!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Understood. I shall start searching...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Woderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If I wait here, I'll be able to talk to them?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes. They are preparing for when the park closes and their guests arrive so that they can show them around...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Until then, they each appear to be busy with other meetings and business matters.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: For you to see them together, waiting for them to greet their guests seems to be the only opportunity you will receive given the circumstances...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Thank you so much, Mr. Mascot!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: You're welcome... But you have some time until the park closes, so what would you like to do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go on a little walk...
Dreamland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (After wandering for a while, I ended up here...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And we'll need to decide soon which attraction to scrap next.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Trampoline Dome seems like a viable candidate. It's a low-yield attraction that's only meant for children so...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Ready...! Jump!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: And... Jump!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Those voices... They're coming from the Trampoline Dome.)

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: It's almost time to go home, you two...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: No! I wanna play on the trampoline some more!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Alright, alright. Just a little longer then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: C-Could they be siblings...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Saki played here when they were kids too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Keisuke and Shosuke said that kids stop coming here when they grow up but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If one of their precious memories just vanishes... That would be way too sad...)

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting Phoenix Wonderland. The park will be closing shortly.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Alright, you two. They're saying we have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Boy & Girl
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Hahaha. If you like this place so much, we can come again.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Then...! Can we come play on the trampoline again?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Of course. It'll always be waiting for you here.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Really?! Then let's come again tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
Well, tomorrow might be tough...
But we'll definitely come again.

rows.Speaker: Boy & Girl
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu, is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Saki isn't the only one that really truly loves this place...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah. My brothers and I just don't know that there could actually be a ton of people that really care...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I don't want just new visitors to come. I want everyone that's been here before to smile too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means I have to stop them!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I can't wait, I can't wait♪
When will homeroom finish,
I can't wait♪)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're gonna need to move as a cohesive unit! We'll start by shouting our battle cry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Female Teacher
rows.Line:
And that's it for announcement.
Please go home safe, every...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Byeee!

rows.Speaker: Female Teacher's Voice
rows.Line: O-Otori! No running in the hall!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Sorry...!
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm heeere!!

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Oh, it's the Miya Girls student again. I wonder what she's doing here since it's such a long way...

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: Who knows? Maybe her best friend goes here or something?
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha...! E-Emu?! Why are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? But I said hello to everyone on the way here so...♪

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha. You're so polite...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Anyway, we gotta get to club soon. Just don't let any teachers see you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! See you later♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... They just left me here to deal with you alone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*... And why did you come up to my class? What happened to waiting by the gate?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I really wanted to see you guys♪ Hey, let's go find Nene and Rui too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, okay! Just keep your voice down! If a teacher finds you...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm, oh... Did you forget something?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: No! There's a teacher patrolling the hallways! They'll be here soon!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu! Quick, hide under a desk and...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, hide and seek♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, hide and seek...! If we manage to not get caught by any teachers, we win! Okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aye aye, Cap'n☆

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's you lot.
Not going home yet?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Uh, no. Not yet.
We have club and...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Tsukasa, good luck...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's nice but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (For better or worse, it looks like they don't know that a student from another school managed to sneak in...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We might just get out of here in one piece after all.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hm? This teacher... Didn't I run into them the last time I came here?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehehe. Time for a quick look...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Owwy...! I bumped my head...!)

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher
rows.Line:
What was that? Wait...
Did that desk just move?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-No...!
I, uhh...
My foot just got caught on it...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Teehee. Sorry, Tsukasa☆)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Emu, you...!!)
Fight! Check it out! The baseball team's really going at each other's throats!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This voice...!)
Someone! Get a teacher!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's Rui...! And Nene!)

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher
rows.Line: A fight?! We need to stop them! Tenma, go home, now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I will...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. That was sooo much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fun?! Do you even know how to play hide and seek?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui! Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I heard some commotion coming from outside and thought it might be you, so I came to see and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was close, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was, but you saved our skins.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Our teamwork really shined there☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So let's keep this up and do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To think that you were as down as you were a few days ago... Like night and day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this is the Emu we're used to so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, shall we head over to SEKAI before a teacher finds us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. We still have a mountain of work to plan out and think about before we can actually start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! SEKAI, here we come♪
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The chief director for this operation will be the Wonder Stage's own Rui Kamishiro! The singing and dancing will be led by Sakurako Seiryuin of the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regarding anything else, feel free to ask me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's get this show on the road!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Nope♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm super duper happy that everybody at Phoenix Wonderland wants to help us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We need to do everything we can too then.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! So let's start by...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Emu!
We're about to begin practicing. Mind helping us out a bit?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: Sorry, there's something we thought that we should discuss first...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you know them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. They've all been doing shows here since when grandpa was still around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I had no idea...
S-So what is it that you'd like to discuss with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: It's that... We're sorry, Emu!!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Members
rows.Line: We felt the need to apologize to you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member A
rows.Line: Your grandfather took the time to always look after us, but we ended up making you have to do all of this...

rows.Speaker: Experienced Cast Member B
rows.Line: We didn't like the way this park was changing and knew that everyone else felt the same way.

Also, didn't you just come back from the Seaside School?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, but I didn't get to go with Tsukasa, Nene and Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been wanting to go to the beach with all of them too♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, we suspected as much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You guys knew already?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: No, your mascot friend told us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You mean Mr. Mascot?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. Soon after that, Shosuke found a suitable location that happened to be right on the beach...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
K-Keisuke!
You're making it sound like I chose this venue just for her!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: For your information, that isn't the case whatsoever.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It happened to be the most optimal location from a business standpoint in terms of location and potential for promoting the park.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Otherwise, we wouldn't be sending you there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whatever you say...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Why are you grinning?
If you're still not convinced, you can see the data for yourself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not that, Shosuke♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm just really really happy that we get to work together on something together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So let's do the best we can, Shosuke, Keisuke☆

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, that's the plan.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Okay, okay, we get it.
Go take your bath already.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The sea♪ The sand♪
Everybody at the beach♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Great, she's skipping now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It's been a while since this house has had such a lively atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I think I preferred it more when things were quiet.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But it's nice to see Emu smiling like this again...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We may've been guilty of robbing her of that all this time.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now, we need to protect that smile.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Not just our family either. We need to make sure everybody who comes to visit Phoenix Wonderland also goes home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...
Swimming Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's time to start our beach volleyball match!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I got it!
Spike it, now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Fire!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, that was quite the spike...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Why are you running, Nene? You won't win if you keep doing that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu's the one that scored, not you.
Also, there's no way I can dig that! I'd break my wrists if I tried!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, I didn't expect to use so much energy just on beach volleyball. I'm exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Luka seemed to be enjoying herself too. I'm sure she's getting in some beauty sleep in SEKAI now.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beach volleyball was very fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You joining in was probably the biggest surprise of all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ It was so awesome how Robo-Nene could make the ball spin like a top whenever she spiked it! Oh, and how it drilled into the sand too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that, she can do jump float serves... How on earth is that even possible?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Robo-Nene's a valuable member of our troupe. Isn't it a good thing that she's capable of such feats?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Robo-Nene, how are you in terms of charge?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... 65% remaining.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That should do since all that's left is to clean everything up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it may be wise to put you in power saver mode just in case.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Understood. Entering power saver mode.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sleep tight, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We still have some time before our ride gets here, right? Wanna stay on the beach while we wait?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure. It'd be nice to sit and rest a little too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, the waves shouldn't reach here and... Oh, the sand isn't as hot as I thought it would be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'll sit right next to you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How does a quick break sound, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like we're really making the most of our youth when we're together like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That actually sounds really weird coming from you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But this is nice.
The sea's so pretty too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Being able to enjoy the scenery like this is nice since we ran into some trouble there in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It reminds me of when my big brothers, big sister and I went to see the ocean...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We went on a family vacation a really long time ago and everybody came along♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really...? I have a hard time imagining your older brothers going on a trip like that based on how they are now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! Keisuke took an encyclopedia of sea creatures with him, and the four of us went exploring on the beach!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
Shosuke, look!
It's a jellyfish!

rows.Speaker: Little Shosuke
rows.Line: Wah! No, don't come any closer!

rows.Speaker: Little Shosuke
rows.Line:
And why are you holding it?!
What if you get stung?!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line:
This one won't sting me.
Right, Keisuke?

rows.Speaker: Little Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, you should be safe.
It even says so right here.

rows.Speaker: Little Hinata
rows.Line: Oh... Emu, Keisuke, Shosuke, over here! There's a pool full of starfish!

rows.Speaker: Little Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Little Keisuke
rows.Line:
Nice find, Hinata.
Let's see if these are safe to touch too.

rows.Speaker: Little Shosuke
rows.Line: Stop finding things will you, Hinata?! And can't you just say that they're poisonous or something, Keisuke?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We couldn't take anything home with us but we all had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that does sound like quite a bit of fun. However, some parts of that story did concern me a little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you and your family visit the beach often, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, not really. Dad was always busy with work, so we haven't gone on a trip as a family since then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But what about you guys?
Did you ever go to the beach with your families and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can't say that I have...
When I was little, most of our family outings involved visiting museums and science halls.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, you would've found me down by the river more than the beach. I remember trying to find fossils and precious gems.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That sounds just like you, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember you showing me some fossils and gemstone ores that you found one time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, what about you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean if I ever went to the beach? I mean, sure, my family took me there a few times...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they were always too crowded so we usually ended up going to a pool by our house instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Same. My family was more pool-oriented. I remember going there pretty often with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki wasn't really able to go in the water, but we were at least able to splash each other with water from the side of the pool.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Saki was sick for a really long time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She was, but she did get a chance to see the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She got to stay at a seaside hotel, go looking for seashells and even smash watermelons.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She didn't get a chance to swim in the ocean, but she still got to enjoy herself.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki must've had such a big smile on her face when she was doing all those things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, her smile very nearly outshined the sun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still...
It's surprising that we don't have many memories involving the sea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then it's a good thing we came here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I was exhausted towards the end, but it was nice to visit the beach for once.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope we get to come back again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I hope so too!
The day before the U.S. trip
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: America, America, here we come!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've got my passport, enough clothes and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh yeah...
I need to bring a new notebook for ideas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wonder what Mr. Riley's park's gonna be like...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (All of his characters are super famous, so I bet there's gonna be lots of really exciting shows and heart-pounding attractions.)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, we'll have a steep hill to climb if we were to try and implement all these ideas...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You've definitely come up with some excellent ideas, and they'll surely help us attract more visitors by putting them into practice...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
But reality isn't so kind.
We don't have the budget or manpower to pull this off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
Sorry, I didn't really think about any of that...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Partnering with Riley Entertainment will mean we'll need a bigger cast. Should we start putting out “help wanted” ads?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: No, we'll need to be more tactful about this. Any new cast members we hire will need to be trained, which is a burden the veteran cast members will have to carry.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We may need to rethink how we train new hires. Can you try discussing this with HR, Shosuke...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I still don't understand Phoenix Wonderland the way Keisuke and Shosuke do...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I just couldn't give up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Phoenix Wonderland to be “a place that makes everyone smile” forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't care if you replace all the rides and get rid of the stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just don't want it to stop being a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure that as long as we try to do that, we'll get more and more guests to come and visit... Please...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Keisuke, Shosuke and Dad were willing to hear me out.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So now it's my turn to learn more about how they see things and run the park.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Hinata's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Come on in!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, you're still packing for tomorrow.
Do you have everything you need?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm all set! Shosuke even said, “Worst case scenario, you'll be fine as long as you have your passport.”

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Have you packed your clothes already? I recommend taking at least one dress along since some places over there have dress codes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's a great idea, Sis!
Let's pick one out together♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Sure. Can you show me your closet?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Alright, you should be all set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
That just leaves your daypack.
Have you packed a handkerchief and tissues?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm thinking about taking this one along! Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, that's a limited-edition Phenny pattern. Didn't that come out a really long time ago?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been saving it for a special occasion, so I decided to take it to see the United States☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Be sure not to lose it over there.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But you really get to go to America. I'd be going with you if it weren't for my classes.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
C'est la vie.
Please bring a nice souvenir for me, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Wait, I need to make sure that I don't forget my idea notebook!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, you mean this...?
What happened to that really cute one you always use?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is to help me study!
