rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Help you study?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna ask Mr. Riley all about his company since Keisuke and Shosuke are also coming with us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna learn everything I can about running a business!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: (I was under the impression that Mr. Riley invited you to his park because he wants you to just have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
That's very noble of you, Emu.
I didn't realize you had so much on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But be sure to go to bed early and get a good night's rest for tomorrow, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but I should write down what I want to ask Mr. Riley before I fall asleep!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Please have lots and lots of fun while you're over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will♪
A few days after returning
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What a wonderhoy morning!!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Don't you mean obnoxious?
My ears are ringing.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Is something special happening today, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I brought back souvenirs for everyone and gonna hand them out at school!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And after school, I'm gonna talk with the others about what we all learned when we went to Mr. Riley's park!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Ah, to reflect upon your experiences?
It's good to hear that you'll be exchanging ideas in such a manner.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a great idea, right?! Tsukasa said that he wanted to discuss acting, and I wanna talk to Nene about singing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Rui's gonna talk about how everything was produced♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You can see it all right here!
We've got lots to talk about!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, that's the notebook you took with you on your trip. But...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. It's covered in all these cute and shiny stickers now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I was gonna write all about how to run a business and stuff, but I decided to also include some fun exciting stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to tell everyone about all the things I wrote down in here!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It sounds like you have a wonderful day ahead of you. Be sure to put your best foot forward today, Private Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am☆
After school
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yahohoy! We get to start practicing again today!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu, I get that you're excited, but try to keep it down, will you?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... I could be telling you the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I understand how you both feel.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There are several new effects that I've been aching to try as well. Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are we supposed to feel excited or scared...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also! Nene, where's Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right over here.
Robo-Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Welcome back, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're back! We even got you some souvenirs, Robo-Nene! We'll make sure to give them to you later!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's begin by going over what we learned during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all made sure to bring notes, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup♪ Look! Look!
My notebook's filled with lots and lots of stuff☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? From what I remember, the cover for your notebook seemed much more mundane while we were over there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
It's covered in shiny stickers now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ This notebook was originally about “learning about running a business”, but I decided to change it to being about “balancing dreams and reality”!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, listen!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your “ability to dream” is an absolutely essential part of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-He's right...!
We've been able to do what we have because you never stop dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, we wouldn't be here right now if it weren't for big dreamer, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even when it was all run down, weren't you the one who wanted to bring smiles and laughter back to the Wonder Stage more than anybody else?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your dream gave us a place where we could belong.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys and Mr. Riley taught me that my dreams have actually been bringing smiles to people's faces. I finally understand that now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that it's okay for me to keep dreaming and wanting to do lots of different things...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So... Hehe♪ I gave my boring, old notebook a really shiny makeover☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's become wonderfully swirly-whirly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Swirly-whirly? I can see that it's shiny, but what makes it so “swirly”?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh... Here! Right here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look at where all the stickers are...
Then, see what's right next to them...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Stars, flowers, fish, animals...
Is it safe to assume that all these objects and creatures are dancing round and round?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, is this supposed to be the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Different stories, worlds, animals and stuff all intertwined in a big dance... Is that what this represents?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That's right, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been friends for a while now, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you're finally admitting that you're one of us...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Welcome to the fun side, Nene!
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what..? “Fun”...?
I'd rather not be dragged into a band of lunatics.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It won't be easy to keep dreaming while trying to also keep an eye on reality, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for making me realize that I've been making a difference! Let's keep doing our best and do lots more stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're a bit late to the party, but yes, of course! After all, we're members of the same troupe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm looking forward to doing more too.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will also do everything I can to make people around the world smile!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's put on a show that's going to make everybody everywhere smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's do it!
It's gonna be so wonderhoy!
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright! We don't have practice today, so I can think about what my cake's gonna be like!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... Where did my Secret Valentine's Day Alliance notebook go...? Aha, there you are♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now I remember! Airi said that we should all bake chocolate cakes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because if we're all baking the same thing, we can share ingredients with each other if one of us happens to make a mistake.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She also said that we should get a more specific idea of how we want to decorate them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Airi put so much thought into making sure our surprises succeeded.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (She was even nice enough to show me how to put my ideas into practice!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot♪ I should see what I can find on the baking sites she recommended!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow! Cookies, candy and gummies!
So many yummy sweets☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're all super cute and look delicious, but I need to find... Chocolatey♪ Chocolatey cakes♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, how about this one?!
Click☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! So many chocolate cakes!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is amazing!
The chocolate frosting on this one's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, this one has lots of chocolate nibs and shavings on it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wish I could make cakes like these! They're all so adorable and look really yummy on top of being gorgeous!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hmm... But I'm trying to make a show stage out of mine, so this probably isn't the best way to go...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want the one I'm giving Keisuke, Shosuke and Sis to be really zing-zang-zoom too!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm? A message...?
Oh, it's from Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Emu, I found this just a second ago.
This site has some really interesting cakes on it.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I have a feeling that one of these is pretty close to what you're hoping to make! I hope you get a chance to check them out!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A-Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's amazing!
How did she know I was looking at cakes just now?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway...
<Thank you so much, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Talk about a coincidence!
I guess I deserve some points for perfect timing, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Also, I should be able to help you with most of the cakes on either of those sites, so don't be afraid to come up with something really spectacular!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow... Airi's really the best...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to come up with something really, really good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! This one has rainbow-colored frosting on it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And this one's completely black!
Haha. I wonder what that tastes like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, this one has animal macarons!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be great if I could make some that look like the plushies from SEKAI! I should write this down...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A surprise piñata cake?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, there's even a video.
Hehe. Let's have a look. Click!

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <From the outside, it looks just like an ordinary cake! Doesn't it look delicious...?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it does♪

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <However, just as you try to take a slice out of it... Are you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm ready. I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line:
<Surprise!
Bits of chocolate come flying out of the cake!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <And by taking a slice out of this cake...>

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <Oh look! It's hollow on the inside like Baumkuchen or Bundt cake! Ah, someone must've filled this with tiny cookies!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <Could it be that all ring cakes are filled with delicious sweets? Just kidding! Or am I?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, they totally should be!

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <In any case, these piñata cakes are a great way to surprise someone!>

rows.Speaker: Video Narration
rows.Line: <From the moment they take their first slice all the way up to their first bite, they'll be all smiles!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be just as fun as opening a treasure chest!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My chocolate cake could be the tent KAITO and the others always use...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And when they open it... Surprise!
All these edible plushies would come bursting out!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
Just thinking about it makes me feel all wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, if I'm gonna do that, I should make Miku, Robo-Nene and everyone else too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The cake would look like this...
The plushies would be hiding in the middle, while Miku's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I'll call it the “Wonderhoy ☆ SEKAI Cake”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I ended up writing all of those ideas down♪)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I don't know how many I'll actually get to use...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But I want them all to really smile...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll ask Airi again to see what she thinks and try to use as many of these ideas as I can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to baking, but I can't wait to show everyone what I've made!
Valentine's Day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Today's the day.
Are you both ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! I'm really looking forward to seeing how Ichi and the others react!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
I can't wait to see the look on everyone's faces☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone from the Wonder Stage, everyone from SEKAI and...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't wait to surprise Sis and the others♪)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, you both sound good and ready. Let's do this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Secret Valentine's Day Alliance, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm glad they liked my surprise so much.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Drum rooolll... Ta-daa!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Nene, Rui!
Happy Valentine's Day!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Just thinking about it puts a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The plushies seemed to really like it too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, that just leaves...!
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, Emu! I didn't know you were home!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Sis! Oh, Keisuke, Shosuke, you're both home too!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yes, we are. Do you have to make a fuss about it every time?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Can't you be a little nicer to her, Shosuke?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Also, Emu, here are your Valentine's Day chocolates. You caught me just after I'd already given Keisuke and Shosuke their gifts.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! This bear wrapping paper's so cute! Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Isn't it? I thought you'd like it, so I had them wrap it in that.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: The actual chocolates even look like animals. They're really almost too cute to eat.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Maybe I should save them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: By the way, where are Mom and Dad?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Mom's still away on a business trip, so she won't be back for some time.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Dad's having dinner with some clients, which means he won't be home until late.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I was hoping to give my gift to everyone when they were all here, but I guess I don't have much of a choice.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, Sis, Keisuke, Shosuke, I think it's time I showed you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, you got us all something?
I can't wait to see what!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They're like this every year without fail.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Don't be like that, Shosuke.
Especially since Emu went out of her way to get gifts for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait just one second!
Mr. Chef, if you will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Here is it!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I made this with my friends from school♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You made this, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But... It looks fairly plain.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Then you get to cut it, Shosuke♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
What? No, I'll pass...
I've got a really bad feeling about this.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
In that case, why don't I cut it?
I'll cut six pieces and start from here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Here goes nothing.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Hm? It feels like the knife's stuck on something solid.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me there's something we're not supposed to eat in there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now, Keisuke, open up the cake from where you just cut♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Open it? Like this?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Wait, there's...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Wh-What is this?!
This cake's bursting at the seams with sweets!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know what this is! It's a piña-something cake!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Piña-something...?
Is that supposed to be some kind of cute joke?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
I wasn't joking.
It's really called something like that.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I believe this is called a piñata cake.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: See? I knew it had that “ñ” sound in it.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Okay, okay, I get it.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I remember seeing something like this during a business trip to the U.S. Where did you come up with this idea, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A second-year friend showed me this site that showed people how to make them☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It looked really fun and I thought that it'd be a great way to surprise everyone because of all the goodies hiding inside, so I decided to make one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, Keisuke, I went with this because I know you don't like chocolate that much. Please, try some if you can, okay?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see.
Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: This really surprised me too, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You've come such a long way since we made sweets together when we were little!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Maid
rows.Line: Ms. Emu, I just received word that your mother's trip will be wrapping up sooner than expected and will be coming home early.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That means she'll also get to see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
O-Oh no!
We already opened it!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Right...
Mr. Chef, is there a way to close it up again?

rows.Speaker: Chef
rows.Line:
Yes, I can do that.
I shall take this back to the kitchen to begin working on that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Mr. Chef! Please, save our cake!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
That's great, Emu.
This means it'll be a piñata again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Also, Keisuke, Shosuke, I believe it goes without saying that you'll both need to do some acting for our second take.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're going along with this, Keisuke...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! If we take a video, we can show Dad what we did later, right?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Good idea. Why don't I take one for you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You will?! Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Mom, I hope you get home soon.)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? You seem awfully tired.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did you overdo it during practice today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I still have about four shows worth of energy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? How can a person have that much stamina...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. But this is Emu we're talking about.
At the same time, if you're not tired...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, are you worried about how Tsukasa's doing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, I'm worried too. It's been almost two weeks since we started practicing lines without him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But all we can really do right now is wait for him to figure this out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for him?)
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was really good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Keisuke and Shosuke!
Welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, we're back.
Would you please not tackle me while shouting like that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You're lucky that all you have to do is smile and nod.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: By the way, how's practice going for your next show as ambassadors?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hm? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see...
He's having trouble getting into character...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Everyone knows “A Pianist Named Thorpe”... But they're nothing like each other. It's no wonder he's having so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I mean, you didn't have to go with a tricky story like this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
B-But Tsukasa's trying really hard!
He's been thinking lots and lots about how Thorpe thinks! He's even reading all these different books about him...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
He'll figure it out.
That's what you're hoping, right, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: In that case, we're in no position to say anything.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hmph...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Alright, setting that aside...
Are you having discussions and giving each other food for thought between practices?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Food? Like the Salisbury steak I had today?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Not actual food!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'm talking about reporting, relaying and talking about what you've all been doing! And giving each other food for thought for mental stimulation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what you meant!
Like stop, drop and roll!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
That's only for fire emergencies!
Ugh! We're getting off-topic!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shosuke's trying to ask if you're sharing what you're all doing with one another, as well as how you've been progressing.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
Because I'm sure practicing for a show's a multistep process.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: How are you going to know what to do when you meet back up if you don't know what your other troupe members have been practicing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: To be fair, they have that director fellow at the helm, so I'm sure things are mostly under control...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try asking Rui and the others about this! Thanks, Keisuke, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Anytime. We'll be looking forward to good results.
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see. I had a feeling that we'd have to sit down and discuss this at some point.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Especially since the three of us already made some adjustments to our lines, and changed some of the timing for when we enter and exit the stage while working on our lines.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. These scenes all involve Tsukasa in some way, so things will likely go smoother when we do meet back up if we tell him all this in advance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, a quick brainstorming session would likely mean that I'd be the one telling him what we discussed...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But it seems like you already have an idea, Emu. Why don't you lead us off?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here's my idea!
*Whisper*
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Oh, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Morning!
Did you catch that show last night?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sneaky sneak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... What's taking Tsukasa so long?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu, wait.
People are gonna see you if you stick your head out like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You can always look at my drone's footage if you want to see what he's doing. I brought a bigger tablet along just for that purpose today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really hope our idea ends up working.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here's my idea! Tsukasa's probably got himself twisted up in knots because he's thinking really, really hard about this, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Instead of just telling him what we've been doing, I was thinking that we could make it more fun somehow♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More fun?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ I mean, spinach always tastes better after you cook and season it, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're not wrong, but...
Wait, what's that got to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In other words, you think we should go the extra mile for him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! So, I wanna try...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, this is usually when Tsukasa arrives at school... Ah, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, he's here!
But he's still making that face...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm guessing he was thinking about Thorpe the entire way over.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I have to agree.
From here, we'll pursue him to the front entrance using the drone.
Kamiyama High School - Front Entrance

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't think of anything that Thorpe and I have in common...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But I have to find something.
I'll take a look at the original story again after I head up to class.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gwah! Wh-Why's my shoe locker full of party poppers...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? There's something green and leafy in the back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is this? A vegetable? But it feels like a bundle of paper... I thought it might be real for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because I took the time to make that notepad look like real spinach.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd be covered in goosebumps if I ever found anything like that in my shoe locker...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Was there actually any point in making it look that real...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey! Tsukasa's flipping through it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
This leafy green bundle of paper... Is it supposed to be a notebook?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's see...
“Sergeant ☆ Spinach ☆ Reporting ☆ In! From Emu, Nene and Rui.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha. Now I understand. It's supposed to be spinach. No, this still doesn't make any sense...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Wait...
Spinach? Reporting in...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, now I get it!
This is their way of telling me what they've been doing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And they went through the trouble of putting this together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, under “Report” they have...
I see. They've made some adjustments to their lines, and changed some of the timing for when they enter and exit the stage...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Tsukasa just smiled!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like he realized that it's from us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Report: Practices are going well.
We're currently working on the middle scenes.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it sounds like they're doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next, changes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We plan on changing the timing for when the squirrels appear to hear Thorpe play, as well as where they stand on stage. We'll let you know once we've come to a decision.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Understood.
We'll probably need to make further adjustments once we meet back up too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that just leaves the discussion section... H-Huh...? What's with this drawing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is it an apple?
But it isn't red... This color means it must be a pear!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A green pear...?
Like a green light to keep going because there's nothing else to discuss!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're getting things done during practice without me present.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that means I need to keep trying my best too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It worked, Emu.
He actually smiled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
“Operation Smiling Spinach” was a big success♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! I need to go...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene! Rui!
Thanks for helping me with this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa, this is about all we can do for you right now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But we're hoping that you'll come back to us soon!)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Rui!
We're done cleaning up over here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're just about done as well, so we can call it a day after we get changed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good work, everyone.
If we keep this up, we should be more than ready for our ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Not only that, we get to do it in Okinawa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. It'll be the furthest we've ever traveled for one of these shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait☆
And we get to go on Shosuke's cruiser♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! He also told me to ask you guys about something!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Does it have to do with our ambassadorial performance?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, it has to do with what we can do while we're on his cruiser. He said that we'll have time to stop somewhere for a few hours to play in the ocean, and he told me to ask how you guys would feel about that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, he's letting us do that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Doing that after we've put on our show seems fine, but before...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may not be easy for us to practice while we're aboard the cruiser, so we could take that opportunity to relax a little before our show, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's also true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! What do you guys wanna do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I already asked if we can try doing some water skiing♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Water skiing?
As in being towed by a boat while wearing skis?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds incredibly fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
But he said that we couldn't because we might get hurt!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We can't?!
To be fair, we probably shouldn't take too many risks before our show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But he said he'd be okay with looking for an instructor after we do our show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That sounds really scary. I think I'll be okay with just watching...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, what happened to coming up with things to do while we're aboard the cruiser?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, right...
So, what do you guys wanna do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we'll be out on the water, I'd like to do some fishing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure what I want to do yet...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's gonna be warm and I might get sunburnt, so I might just relax inside the cabin since it should be nice and cool.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I think I'll get in some reading.
It'll be wonderful to do so while getting a taste of the sea breeze.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I'll be more than satisfied as long as I get to see Tsukasa and the rest of you battle it out with the fishes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! Alright, I'll just have to catch something so big that it leaves you completely speechless!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? Something so big...?
Like the Earth?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Are you insinuating that I'm going to get my hook caught on some corals or rocks below the surface?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That and an old boot to complete the picture.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... Again with the mockery!
Just you wait! I'll catch me some snappers, tuna, shrimp, flounders or what have you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why shrimp?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, they'll be nice and plump.
Really yummy too if we grill or fry them right there♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Tsukasa, you seem awfully confident in your abilities. Have you fished before in the past?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Down by a river when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, that's it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What of it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That makes you a total novice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh. I may be a total novice...
However, my victory is assured!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I have beginner's luck on my side!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means your success is based on pure chance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! That's so cool, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, there's just no way. If dumb luck alone lets you catch snappers and tuna, then you'd be bringing the fishing industry to its knees.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! Say these things while you can! I'll show you all when we're aboard the cruiser!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, fishing it is♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What else do you guys wanna do?
It's okay for us to come up with lots and lots of ideas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
I mean, I'm not really sure what else we can do while we're out at sea...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we do a quick search on our phones? We may come across some fun and interesting activities.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. Let's take this time to come up with things to do while we're aboard the cruiser.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you all ready to rehearse?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After we got off that island, we've been scrambling to practice and get ready, but we finally made it to this point.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and Robo-Nene was also able to receive some much-needed maintenance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness you got looked at before you got all rusty, Robo-Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I was afraid that I'd have to change my name to “Robo-Nene the Rust Bucket”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. We wouldn't want that to happen, now would we?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. We like you the way you are, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, everyone! I know we usually don't, but we're going to give this rehearsal everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, we get it.
There's no point in rehearsing unless we treat it like the real thing, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely!
Anyway, we're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, I'm gonna move over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke! Wait, Keisuke, you're here too?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Ah, there you are.
How's your rehearsal going?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're just about to get started☆
I'll be appearing from over here♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know you were coming to Okinawa too, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Oh, I rushed over as soon as I received word that you all became stranded...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But I'm glad to see that you're neither hurt nor ill.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm so full of energy that I can't stay still☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, I really can't wait to show you our show♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. As usual, you seem to be in as good a mood as ever.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Wait, where did that come from...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I was just describing what I saw.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, um... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Anyway, since your rehearsal's about to start, we should probably move somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We're leaving the show in your troupe's hands, Emu. Give it everything you have as per normal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We will! We're gonna do our best to make sure the audience smiles from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke's Voice
rows.Line: So, about what we were discussing... Everything that happened during this voyage was all my fault...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I wish I'd checked the weather forecast more closely and learned more about the surrounding islands beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I was far too hasty with my preparations and wasn't able to deal with the inclement weather as a result. And I ended up putting everybody's lives in danger...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I have no excuse for what happened this time around. I'm prepared to take full responsibility for what happened.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Take responsibility...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But he's an adult... And the managing director... Even if I tried to say something, he'll probably just...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
Keisuke, Shosuke, listen♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh? You're still here...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! There's something I forgot to tell you, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ Guess what? We got to do some fishing when we were aboard the cruiser! And then, I felt something really big get caught on my line!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried to reel it in, but it wouldn't budge at all! That was when I had Tsukasa help me out...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And it turned out that we were trying to reel in the Earth☆

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Emu...
Should you be getting ready to rehearse instead of telling us that story...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
We decided to have some sandwiches for lunch and all these seagulls started flying towards us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, Robo-Nene used her angry eyes to scare them off and we got to eat our sandwiches in peace!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
After that, Rui got really seasick...
I think it was because he was reading the whole time, but we all did our best to make him feel better!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, we all had a lot of fun on the cruiser!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Shosuke worked really, really hard to fix the radio while we were on that desert island! That's why we were able to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! Shosuke, my hair's gonna be a mess...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Quiet, you. I know you'll have time to fix it before you go on stage. Also, what's a kid like you doing trying to cover for an adult?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu, did you have fun during this trip?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup...! It was super duper extra fun!
I'm sure Tsukasa and the others will say the same!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu!
The rehearsal's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sorry, I've gotta get going!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll have a chance to discuss all this later, but at the very least, you all seem to have enjoyed yourselves very much...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I'm glad for you, Shosuke.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Me too...
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, there we go!
You both had these beautiful smiles on your faces☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, next, it's doodling time♪
Let's draw lots and lots of stuff together, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Taking a picture's only half of the story...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can you take care of this part, Emu? I'm not really all that confident in my drawing skills...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you sure? It's not that hard. All you have to do is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Place smiley-face stamps here, here and here! Throw in lots and lots of these sparkly star effects!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow! Your picture's becoming so colorful and sparkly!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we can put a pair of cat ears on Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh my gosh! Nene, you look adorable!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, the cat ears themselves are cute...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But are you sure about adding in all these extra things, Emu? I thought we were being judged mainly based on the actual picture we take...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll be fine♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure that the judges are gonna smile from ear to ear when they see that we had a ton of fun making this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup yup! I agree 100%!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So... Here, the pen's all yours!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, you want me to...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course! We should be having fun by working on it together, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but... What am I supposed to do exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know☆ Let's give me a mustache!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A mustache?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right about... Here♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Hehe...
I can't believe you actually gave yourself one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, Nene, you're smiling.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See?!
You can't help but smile after seeing our picture!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that, but a mustache seems a little unfair.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still...
Okay, I'll also try drawing something that'll make everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, what about here?
The bottom left corner's still kinda empty!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're right.
Hmm... What to draw...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Staring at me like that probably isn't really helping...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Whoa...!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, aren't these the singing flowers from SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, they are. I thought that it'd be nice to include them since we're using all these smiley-face stamps.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, all I did was draw some flower petals around them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I love your idea!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah, me too!
Oh, I know! What if you drew in some musical notes to make it look like they're singing?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's an amazing idea!
I'm gonna do that right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's keep going, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Awesome! Our stickers look funtastically good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, they do.
We still have a little time left. Do you wanna keep going or stop here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, wait. There might still be more you can do for this picture!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?
No, you're right! The upper right corner's a little empty!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll draw a circle here and make it all spiky. Then draw another one here and throw in some whooshes...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
All done!
Here, can you guess who I drew?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I know! It's Tsukasa, Rui and me!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We have a winner!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. You did a great job, Emu.
You captured Tsukasa's inflated sense of self and Rui's usual look of satisfaction perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At the same time, what made you choose them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Rui are working really hard to move that big prop for us today, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought we could show them our appreciation by giving them these along with those tickets!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The tickets are one thing, but giving them these might be really embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they'll probably really appreciate it too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah, exactly!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to show them what we made!
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The gaming tournament was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And we won!
Which means we get to see that show with Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... What do you wanna do after this? They're heading over here once they're done moving that big prop, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I know the tournament's all done, but let's wait here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There were a ton of games that we didn't play during it, so I wanna play some of them with you, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You do?
In that case, I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, look!
Let's play that car-driving game♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We got to play so much☆
The game with all the cars, that fighting game and some claw machines!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we did. Also, Emu, you really blew me away just now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I only gave you some pointers on how to play these games. You were the one who actually pulled everything off immediately.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because you gave me a lot of really good advice, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For example, for that fighting game, you told me when and where to strike while watching from behind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I wasn't really teaching per se that time... I got a bit excited after seeing that you and your opponent were really well-matched...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That means you had a lot of fun too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, I did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, what do you wanna play next?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Eenie... Meenie... Miny...
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, look!
That game looks really musical!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's a rhythm game with a lot of Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna try that next!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
You can go first.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Thanks, Nene!
Let's see... Oh, I'll play this song☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you just set it to EXTREME mode...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Start the music♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Miku!
Nene, look she's dancing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, the video's really cool, but look at the game screen! You have to hit the buttons that correspond to the symbols that fall towards you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There! That one! Got it! Not so fast!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bam! Bam! Hop! Skip! And! Jump!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-How's she doing this...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's actually possible to do this on your first try...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene, look!
I missed a few, but I cleared it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, you did. I sorta can't believe it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We probably would've had a much easier time winning the gaming tournament if they had us play a music game.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? The screen's asking me to enter in my name.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you must've gotten the top score.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see. You can use the name on your player card or come up with a new one...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... But you only get three characters if you enter in a new name. I'll need more than that for EmuOtori.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're gonna use your real name...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Normally, people use their nickname or something. Didn't I mention that when we were making our cards?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right. Then, I'll use the name we came up with for my card!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: By the way, Nene, what name did you choose?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I usually use the same name whenever I play anything and chose that for my card...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay! That means it didn't take long at all for you to make yours!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, what's your name?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Pomero...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pomero?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's spelled like how it sounds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Pomero...!
That's such a cute name!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Hey, don't shout it out like that.
It's really embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry♪
Is there some meaning behind it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's actually embarrassing, so I'm keeping it a secret.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aww, but I really wanna know!
Hang on! I can try looking it up on my phone♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, no fair!
I'm confiscating that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You'll get it back after you promise to not look it up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...!
Oh, what if I looked it up later in secret?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You still plan on looking it up?! Oh, you...
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Good morning.
And... Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Sis, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Come on, Shosuke, you too.
Quit being so bashful and celebrate your little sister's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh? We aren't kids anymore. Also, who are you calling bashful?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Alright, fine... Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you too, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Mom and Dad even said they'd be coming home early today, which means you get to have a birthday party tonight with all of us there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Including you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, I plan to be there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! I'll do my best to get home early!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, we'd appreciate that.
Also, Emu, there's something we'll need you to do.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You'll need to look at this piece of paper.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A piece of paper? It looks kinda like a letter...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I received that from someone you may or may not know. We don't know what's going on or what's written, but they said you'll understand once you read it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I just have to read it? Then, I'll open it now!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Honestly, dragging us into something so...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's nice. It shows how close they all are.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, Emu, what does it say?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line:
“Go to your place of education!
The next path for you to take shall be revealed there!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Place of education...? So, it's telling me to go to school?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Okay, Private Emu.
Your mission is to go to school as ordered.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Roger!
Private Emu will head out immediately!!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Have fun!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And don't cross any streets without looking first!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: I won't♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope this turns into a wonderful day for Emu.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So do I.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Outside Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wonder what my next path is?
I can't wait to find out what that piece of paper meant♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Emu!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Morning☆
Wait, what are you all doing in front of our classroom?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We were waiting for you, silly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami, Shiho & Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow...! You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here, Emu. This is from us.
We really hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You got me a present?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We discussed at length what to get you and chose very carefully, so I'm sure you're going to enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, what's inside?!
I can't wait to open it☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's about time we gave her the thing. Saki, if you will.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Ahem...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Private Emu, congratulations on making it this far! Here is your next assignment!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's like the one Keisuke gave me!
Oh, Saki, did you also get it from “someone I may or may not know”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ They said, “Hand this to Emu when you're at school!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! You kinda sounded like Tsukasa just now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Oh, um... Y-Yeah, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Saki was given this paper by a man, but there's no guarantee that your brother received his from the same person, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, you're giving away too much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I see...
That means there's more than one culprit at work, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: F-For now, why don't you see what's written?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, right! Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “Congratulations on making it this far. For your second assignment, you are to find the idols after school who hone their craft under the blue sky.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm supposed to find them after school! I can't wait to find out what it means!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you get to have quite a bit of fun after school.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, ready?
One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
Happy birthday, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all so much♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is for you, Otori. From us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow! You all got me a present too, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. Because you're my dear friend.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka, Minori, thank you so much!
You too, Airi, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome! Not only are you my adorable, little junior...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're still members of the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, this is also for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, another assignment!
Who did you guys get this from?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that things will be more fun if we keep that secret until the end, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Agreed. You'll have to deduce that for yourself, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Anyway, why don't you see what's written?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “Congratulations on making it this far. For your third assignment, you are to go to the smile-filled wonderland where those who watch over our thoughts and feelings await.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The smile-filled wonderland...? Does it mean...?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Emu, do you know where your next destination is?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Thanks for the present and relaying my assignment to me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you too, Airi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's your special day, so please have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Go, Emu, go☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-W-Wah...!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You startled me...
Otori, you know you're not supposed to run in the corridors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I'm so sorry...!
There's somewhere I really have to go and...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Isn't it your birthday today? Did you make plans to meet with someone?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes!
But how did you know it's my...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We had a student council meeting during lunch and I just happened to hear Hoshino mention it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, Otori, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
E-Eep...!
See you later, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-That was so scary...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Her eyes weren't smiling at all...
But still, she wished me a happy birthday!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now, I've gotta go see Miku and the others♪
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... That third piece of paper mentioned a “smile-filled wonderland”. It meant SEKAI right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I don't see Miku or anyone else. Where are they?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Right here☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku & KAITO
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Whoa...! I'm being showered with so many flowers...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These flowers are from all of us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We wanted to really surprise you, so we made lots and lots of them♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! You guys made all these?! That makes me super duper extra happy with a cherry on top!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, where are the others?
I really wanna thank them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Guess what?! MEIKO and the others are busy putting together a secret...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: M-Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: E-Emu, you actually have one last assignment to complete! So, you should take a look at this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One last assignment?! Lemme see! Lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line:
“Congratulations of making it this far.
This will be your final assignment... Or is it?”

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “Have you figured who we are yet?”

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “We'll be awaiting you at the stage where it all began!!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The stage where it all began...?!
That means the people who wrote these are...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your dear friends are waiting for you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup yup☆
With something even more fun and explosive than our flower shower...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahem, so! Please come back to SEKAI in a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Roger dodger! I'll be back for sure!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Nene! Rui!
I'm heeeeere!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Private Emu! Congratulations on making it this far!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let us begin by rewarding you for reaching the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ready?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
Emu, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you all so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!!
Y-You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're here?! Even after celebrating at school?! And you have fireworks?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. They're for your birthday party, Emu. We figured that we should prepare a big one since you'd have so many of your friends here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And we really need to thank Azusawa and all of you for helping us out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We wanted to see you guys' surprise to go off without a hitch, so I'm really glad that you invited us to join you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, does that mean you guys wrote all those assignments?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Correct! And Nene was the one suggested that we do something special to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This was your idea, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, well...
I knew you liked surprises, so I thought that it could be fun...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Tsukasa and the others are the ones who gathered everyone to help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
I ended up pulling all the strings I could as a star.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa asked Saki who then asked everybody at Miya Girls. Also, we had Mr. Mascot contact your brothers and such to see if they'd lend us a hand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki, as well as the rest of you!
Thank you for helping us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was fun to be able to celebrate together like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll always be up for fun events like this! Especially if it's a dear friend's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Saki, Honami, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I... I love you all so much...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Cry*
Nene!! Thank you sooo much for coming up with this surprise!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
D-Don't throw yourself at me like that. You almost knocked me over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't tell us that you're satisfied with just this, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. This party's just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! But you guys have already done so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
So, let's get on stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to mark this very special occasion by putting on a show that's going to blow the socks off everyone here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A show?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-Wait, you never said anything about doing a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course we're doing a show!
An authentic surprise performance by none other than us, Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! Wait, what kind of show are we gonna do?! Can I see the script?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, we don't actually have one for you. As such, you'll be free to do as you please throughout our performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As I please?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We have a basic story for the beginning, but how our show ends is gonna depend on how you improvise after that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-That sounds super fun!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We normally don't get to put on shows like these, so you're free to have as much fun as you possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, Emu, to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Up we go...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(From up here...
Everyone's smiles look so sparkly...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They put a big smile on my face, so now it's my turn to do the same for them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want today to be just about me... I want to make it a super special day for everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: It's showtime!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Otori.
I know it was brief, but I'm glad we had a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your fun and energetic personality has this way of cheering up everybody around you, so I hope that doesn't change moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Otori.
I'm glad you enjoyed our surprise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you seemed to really like the snacks we got for you as your present. We really talked a lot about what to get you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We did. Which why we tried gathering all the snacks we could that were yummy and also looked fun to eat or play with!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And the box for your present looked like it was about to burst after we crammed everything in!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But we managed to tie it up with a nice bow, Emu, so please be careful when you open it. Everything inside may come flying out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! Actually, she'd probably really enjoy that! Now, Airi, if you will♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Once again, Emu, happy birthday!
I'm glad that I was able to celebrate with you like this! It turned out to be a really great party!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that show you did for us was something else! It was amazing how it was mostly improvised!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. You and your troupe mates were in perfect sync with one another. We came to throw you a party but ended up being the ones that were entertained.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It definitely felt like a birthday party that was thrown just for you, Otori. It was also easy to tell how much you love shows and seeing everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Totally. I hope you get more and more chances to make people smile with your shows, Emu. I'll be looking forward to seeing what you have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! As a stage performer, there's nothing better than evoking that feeling of surprise and excitement in others, and putting smile on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. And were able to do that because everybody was kind enough to join us to celebrate Emu's special day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, she has so many friends too.
Having Hoshino and the others to help out was nice, but I was so nervous when I asked them about this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it was worth it in the end, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Especially since I got to see Emu smile so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, Emu, happy birthday!
Let's keep putting on the best shows ever and make as many people as we can smile!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
I'm guessing you had a lovely day. I could tell when you returned home today.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Your head was more in the clouds than usual.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, but I believe helping with that surprise was worth it.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. We're happy to see you surrounded by so many wonderful friends. I hope you get to have lots of fun with them in the future!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today was suuuch a super duper incredibly amazing day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene and the others helped come up with ideas...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Saki and everyone else even lent them a hand, so I love them even more now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to take all the happiness I was showered with today and share it with everyone who comes to see our shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep doing everything I can show give them the most wonderhoy shows possible! Yeah!
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, now that you two have learned to draw a good number of animals, let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We drew so many too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, we did...!
But drawing's still very challenging to me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think you've improved a lot compared to when we first started. The cat you drew towards the end was really cute.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-It was? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you for teaching us today, Ena!
It was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I had fun too.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, did you all just finish?
I brought some tea and snacks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
No, this is no big deal.
Please relax and enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
She said this is no big deal...
But these teacups... Aren't they a famous brand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really? These are supposed to be her favorites. Are they that famous?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I went to a nice place the other day for afternoon tea and pretty sure the cups were made by the same brand.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, these look way more intricate...
I've gotta think they're worth a pretty penny...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're just having tea, but I'm starting to feel a little nervous. I need to be careful to not let it slip out of my hand...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
From that painting to these teacups...
Emu, your house is full of all these artistic treasures.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Most of the stuff decorated around the house is stuff my grandpa bought or received from friends as gifts♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He got the painting in the living room from a friend who lives in Europe!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As a gift?! I understand buying a painting like that, but receiving one from a friend?! How?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... Emu's grandfather founded Phoenix Wonderland, so he must've been an incredible human being.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... It's not every day that you get to see such a famous painting up close. It was a real treat for my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, would you like to see more?
The living room isn't the only place where we have stuff on display♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! Also, um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can you tell me more about who drew which painting and any stories associated with them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Didn't your grandfather tell you about them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I heard some stories from him, but he didn't know about all of them. And the person who gave them to him usually did most of the talking...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, I'll give explanations where I can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ Thank you so much, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's wonderful, Emu.
I think I'll take this opportunity to also learn more about art.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, we can learn together♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, let's head down to the living room!
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
This is the living room!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I still can't believe how many famous paintings are on display here. This place really does seem like an art museum...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, Emu, something's been bugging me ever since you led us up to your room...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's Avatino Monapoc's “Acorus Calamus”, right? Is it the original...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... I think so... We have to take it down whenever we loan it out to museums♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm speechless as well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, these paintings are lovely, but so is this end table. It's so beautifully designed...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was made over 100 years ago in England! At least, that's what one of my big brothers said.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a real antique...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
H-Hang on...!
This design... I forget their name, but only one person in the world can make such ornate decorations...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! Is it that rare?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, I didn't know that!
Thanks, Ena! I'm really glad you're here to look at all these things!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm nothing special, really!
I just happened to recognize it is all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, what was that person's name...
I'll try looking them up when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next, we'll head to the room where we chat with our guests!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That concludes our little expedition and tour of my house! What did you both think?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was just one surprise after another. My brain's still having trouble processing everything. Your house has more works of art than some lesser-known art museums...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right. Things that I'd only ever seen in textbooks are on display in your hallway...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought my heart was gonna stop when I saw Kavrough's “Morning Glories”...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's been one of my favorites forever. I really wanted to hang it up in my room...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I was told that it's really hard to maintain and how it's not good to expose it to sunlight.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I asked to have it hung up somewhere close to my room which makes it look like the flowers are in full bloom! And Grandpa found that spot!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. Your grandfather must've been a wonderful person.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ever since I had to say goodbye to Grandpa, I've been greeting those morning glories every day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm hoping that, through them, he'll be able to hear me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right. Those morning glories mean a lot to you because they meant a lot to him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for showing it to us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I think we both learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it was my pleasure! I got to learn so much about all the works of art that Grandpa left to us, so I'm really happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Two antennas popping out of its head♪
They're sending out some really happy signals.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And just like that, you have a giraffe♪

rows.Line: Haha! This giraffe's like a radio station!

rows.Line: I'm gonna paint more waves!

rows.Line: I wanna paint some zig-zaggy waves!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, that's a great idea!
I can't wait to see how all your giraffes turn out♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, I wonder what Honami's painting...)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Honami, are you painting something new? What is it?

rows.Line:
This is a cat wearing a scarf.
Hehe. Quite stylish, no?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I should touch this part up a bit more and...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Wow! Ms. Ena, your bear's so cool!
It's going all, “Grrr!”

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: I-I'm scared. What if it tries to eat me?
