rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah.
It's so hungry that it might just gobble you up whole.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if we paint a bunch of delicious fruits for it to eat, it might become too full to come after you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It may even try to protect you against mean or not-so-nice people as a token of its appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Really?! Then, I'm gonna paint lots and lots of fruit!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Those two sound like they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Hey, Ms. Emu.
I wanna paint a lion but don't really know how...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's try practicing together with the help of a song♪

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here's a circle that's nice and round♪
And lots and lots of pointy spikes!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Whoa! It's a lion's face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready? Whoosh to the right!
And whoosh to the left!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Wow! That's so cool!
It grew whiskers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Paint two little eyes and a little mouth♪ And look at that! It's a lion!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Ms. Emu!
I think I can draw a lion now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm sure you can too!
Let's try painting one together now!

rows.Line: Emu, let's paint together♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami, Ena!
Oh, you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: I wanna sing while painting a lion too!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! Everyone, let's sing and paint some lions together!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, let's paint together!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Okay! I'll paint here!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: I'm gonna paint next to Ms. Honami!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it looks like this is the only bit of wall left. Our zoo will be complete once it's painted up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We can sing while we do too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here's a circle that's nice and round♪
And lots and lots of pointy spikes!

rows.Speaker: Honami & the Kindergartners
rows.Line:
Here's a circle that's nice and round♪
And lots and lots of pointy spikes!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Ms. Emu, I did it! I drew a lion!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that looks amazing!
Let's try coloring it now☆

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Ms. Emu, can you take a look at mine?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Mine too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup! You both did super duper great!
A cute lion and a cool lion!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How are you doing, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Here's mine...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-It's...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's supposed to be a lion...
But it looks like a creature that's suffering in the underworld...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know what it is!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's a lion that's growling, right?
The blob in the back must be its body!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right! But I think I made its mouth a little too big. It sort of looks like it's going to dislocate its jaw...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it has so much impact! I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, Ena, your lion's just so incredible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! She's painting its body and everything!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Lions are nice because they have a lot of unique features, like big, strong legs and tails with cute tufts of fur.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! I can't believe our painting song helped produce such a cool lion!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so amazing! You can get so many different kinds of lions from just one song!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Each one we painted is proof of that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we still have some space left. What animal shall we paint next?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... We painted a bunch of lions, so something that you usually see with it might be good...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Oh, bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Deers!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Zebras!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aren't those all prey...?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: No, they'll be fine because we're painting a zoo! Right, Ms. Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Exactomundo! So, why don't we paint a Ferris wheel for all our animals to go on?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Yeah! We can sing while we do too♪
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? You're gonna go buy some stuff?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we need more flower confetti.
Our show tomorrow will fall short of being perfect without it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi and I will be tagging along.
So, it'll be up to you two to make sure everything is put away and cleaned up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Good luck, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's start checking!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Thanks, you two! Nice work today!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Tomorrow's our big day. Let's give everyone an amazing show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line:
Yes, let's!
But for now, everyone, please get home safe!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Let's go, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One month flew by sooo fast.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it did... We really did a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! And everyone was so nice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. They're all amazing actors, but not snobbish at all. And they were willing to teach us a bunch of stuff...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They showed a lot of interest in Rui's ideas too. In that sense, they seem really open-minded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ Oh, remember how we did some improv before we started practicing? That was really fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It was meant to be a quick exercise to help us get to know each other and see what our acting styles are like, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, Rui, can we get started?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, go right on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Wow☆ Everyone, look over there!
It's a great big gingerbread castle!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She dove straight into the deep end...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, but I'd expect no less from Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I guess we should step in since we know her style the best out of...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“Yes, it's gigantic!
I'd love to see what's inside!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: “Yeah! But where's the entrance?”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
“Oh... Is it that?
Look, it's a door made of chocolate!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line:
“It has to be! Hmm...
This looks like a doorknob... Let's try turning it... Like this!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Hey, hang on! If you turn it like that...! See! Now look what you've done! You broke it!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line:
“Wh-What was I supposed to do?
It's not my fault that it's made of chocolate!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“But... Hm? Oh! It smells so yummy!
Now we know that it's real chocolate!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hey, can I have half of that?
All this work is making me hungry♪”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line:
“Sure, just give me one second.
Let's see if I can split it nicely...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Nene...
Please don't stand there looking dumbfounded, and try to join in.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Agreeing to give Rui's ideas a chance was one thing, but they didn't even hesitate when it came to going along with what you were doing. I honestly can't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, they came up with fun ways to complete the story while clearly presenting what their characters were like.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I really liked the story about chasing the rabbit on the moon! The story about dancing with jellyfish too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But it's all over now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm a little sad too.
It sort of ended just as we were really starting to get to know each other.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we can't stay sad forever since we have to do our show tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do our best to turn our frowns upside down!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We practiced a ton in order to make sure we put on an incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's the spirit, Nene!
Let's do our absolute super duper best to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're back♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We're finally back...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... But I guess that's really it for our ambassadorial performances.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After performing at so many different venues too. The beach, a historical building...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we got to go to the U.S. to learn more about doing shows♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't forget about how we got stranded on a desert island. But I guess even that ended up being fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, I agree.
Despite everything that happened, I'm glad we made it through just fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, a lot really did happen☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We probably wouldn't have had a chance to do these ambassadorial performances if it weren't for them...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Negotiations?
What are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Dad, Keisuke, Shosuke...
I... Um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I just couldn't give up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Phoenix Wonderland to be “a place that makes everyone smile” forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't care if you replace all the rides and get rid of the stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just don't want it to stop being a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I'd convinced myself that dreams and ideals were too frivolous to be bothered with...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you proved me wrong. I realize how great it is to be able to believe in something now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We were able to keep Phoenix Wonderland the way Grandpa wanted it because they were all there to help...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And we were able to put on so many fun ambassadorial shows for the same reason.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu? Why are you staring at the Wonder Stage? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Because it looks more sparkly than usual♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Not just the Wonder Stage!
Everywhere we went!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the guests look so shiny and sparkly because they're smiling so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree. Your brothers did mention how we've been getting more guests as a result of our ambassadorial performances.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I felt really sad when we heard that we'd stop doing ambassadorial performances...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it also made sense since it was a sign that everyone's smiles had made Phoenix Wonderland all better!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanna tell Miku and others later since they were there for us the whole way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we tell them when we go discuss our next show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which!
What do you guys wanna do for our next show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, didn't we just agree to discuss that when we visited SEKAI next?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I was under the same impression...
I suppose that's just Emu for you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just who she is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright... Anyway, Rui, I take it you have some ideas already? You even said that you wanted to discuss something with us while on our way over here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is that true, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I was wondering if we could do a show about an orchestra run by little elves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was thinking about having the stage look like a piano or trumpet with keys or valves. Depending on where you walk, you'd be able to produce different sounds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? But you need to do more than just push down on the valves to play the trumpet...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. That's why I'm also thinking about including a scene where the elves work together to make it produce sound...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it might be fun to make it look like we're frantically scrambling around.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui! Rui! I wanna try doing that show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, we can discuss it with Miku and the others once it's a little more complete.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sounds good. But for now, let's call it a day. I'm sure we're all exhausted since we just finished doing our last ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, see you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See you!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to practice again today!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It's good to hear that your practices are going so well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, they really are! And Tsukasa's been doing an amazing job!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everything from his facial expressions to his body language have been spot-on perfect!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, that reminds me.
Apparently, on the last day, we're supposed to put on a performance at a small auditorium that's being rented out for this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we're allowed to invite guests, so I hope you'll come by to watch!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... Tsukasa said that they'll be doing a show at the end of the workshop, but we haven't been told what they'll be performing yet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was just...wondering what it's gonna be!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
I see...
Let's hope for a nice surprise.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wah!
A message? From who?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... Tsukasa just said that he's running a little late because he wants to ask the person leading the workshop some questions.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: It sounds like he's very hard at work...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's because he's gonna be a star in the future. Hehe. Which means I also need to keep doing my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Especially since so many people are visiting Phoenix Wonderland again.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, even just today...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Look, it's Phenny!
Mommy, can we go take a picture with him?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Let's go ask him for one.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Daddy, let's go on that next! C'mon, hurry!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. Don't worry. It's not going anywhere, so there's no need to rush.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I usually smile whenever I see the guests really enjoying themselves...)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Poochie!
Mommy, Sissy, look! It's Poochie!

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line:
Hi, Poochie!
Wait, doesn't she do shows at the Wonder Stage...?!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Yeah, it's her! You're from the Wonder Stage! Does that mean you're doing a show today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Girls' Mother
rows.Line: Kids, it's rude to point and ask questions like that. I'm sorry. They saw one of your shows the other day and have been your fans ever since.

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: What kind of show are you guys gonna do today?

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, as much as I want to tell you, I have to keep it a secret right now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'll be more than happy to give you a hint☆ Try guessing what we're gonna do based on it♪

rows.Speaker: Girl A & Girl B
rows.Line: A hint...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready?! First, the main character goes all sizzly, bang, boom and hiyaa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And partway through, he goes all zing-zang-zoom! It's a big mystery with a fun climax at the end☆

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: Haha. Sizzly? Boom?

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: I have no idea what you just said, but that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Girls' Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it does. Why don't we all go see it together later?

rows.Speaker: Girl A & Girl B
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: See you later, Wonder Stage Lady!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll be waiting for you at the Wonder Stage and promise to do our best to make sure you all have fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. They really put a smile on my face...!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: That's good to hear, Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Now, Ms. Emu, you need to hurry over to the Wonder Stage or you're going to be late for practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no! You're right!
Rui and Nene are probably waiting for me already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to do my best during practice... For those kids!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go wonderhoy!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Another sunny, sunny day♪
It's so won-won-wonderhooooooy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Someone's in a good mood...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, she is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's this?
Did something good happen to you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really excited about us doing a show with everyone from the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We have some news to report... Or rather, a proposition.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We'd like everyone from both the Wonder Stage and the Phoenix Stage to do a show together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Although it came as a surprise, it certainly is an exciting proposition!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We've been performing alongside them for our night shows, but those also involve quite a few other people who we asked to participate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A show put on by the Wonder Stage and the Phoenix Stage working in collaboration...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to singing with Seiryuin and the others again. Plus, it should be a good learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, considering she claims that the Phoenix Stage is the number one show stage in Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, we may have the power right now to take that honor from them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, calm down. This isn't like the show contest we had to do. We get to work together this time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do everything we can with Sakurako and her friends to put on the most ultra-wonderhoy show ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time, Emu's brothers still haven't told us everything regarding this show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. For now, we should focus on making sure our next regular show succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! We don't have much time left, so we need to make the most of today's practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: How did practice go today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was sooo much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you gotta hear this!
Tsukasa taught us some sword-fighting techniques that he learned during his workshop!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After he did, we discussed how we could work that into our own shows because it's super cool, and Rui decided to add more action scenes!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I see. Then, it seems things are going to get more fun moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Also!
Practicing those action scenes was amazingly fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You should've seen the way Tsukasa went all zing and zow while wielding his sword!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How'd I do?
Was I able to show that I am a proud and powerful hero?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, you've improved quite a lot!
However, you still have some room to grow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he has what it takes to become the hero, but the sword he is about to pull also has the power to save the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As such, I'd like for you to give it that sort of energy as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr! That is easier said than done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But fine!
I shall use my acting prowess to turn this wooden sword into a legendary blade!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What he was doing looked really difficult, but Tsukasa seemed super motivated!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing that even made Nene want to work more on her singing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, I wanna do what I can too!
Which is why I had Rui take a look at how I was making facial expressions and stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I'm sure you and your friends will have no problem putting on a spectacular show, Ms. Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope so too...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Especially since I promised those kids we met earlier that we'd put on a really fun show for them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, something crossed my mind during practice just now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: About how it's really fun to spend time with everyone the way we do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Every day feels like a show and it's super duper fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I found myself wishing that it could go on forever...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I know that every show has to come to an end at some point.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It doesn't matter as long as it has a happy ending where everyone's smiling! That's the best way for a show to succeed☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. So, I'm gonna cherish every minute I spend with them and do my absolute best for every show we do moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like a good plan...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: (There is little that I can really do for you, Ms. Emu, but you have my support.)
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Too slow.
Honestly, where are you looking? Are you not going to catch me?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Stop!
I'm going to catch you no matter what!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, Robo-Phoenix seems to be having no trouble flying and moving around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we should try practicing just as hard as Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I think I'll do some basic strength exercises and go for a run around the park afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll sit here and keep reading through the script, while also keeping an eye on Robo-Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What about you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go find some ducks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To get into character as the Featherbrained Duck, yes? You should be able to find some by the pond.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll head over there now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sneak...
Sneaky sneak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aha! There you are, my duckies...!
Slooowly... I shouldn't scare them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'll start by observing them like Sakurako was talking about!)

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Quack! Quack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, they sorta glide across the water as they swim!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hmm... That one's pecking at a leaf on the surface of the water... Does it think it's food or something?)

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Line: So, Emu, how did it go in practice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: People were surprised. They really didn't know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But once they realized that all they had to do was ring the bell, they began to really enjoy it♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They must've felt more comfortable after figuring out the task at hand, even if they couldn't fully grasp the situation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, some of the pairs were acting kind of uncomfortable after actually putting the wedding wear on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But after the show started, they went right back to their happy selves for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that could be because they weren't used to seeing each other in something so glamorous...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But it seems our show provided just the distraction they needed from those nerves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See?! Which means a vampire was the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, calm down.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Honami and her friends decided to participate♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I gave her one of the tickets my brothers gave me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then, Honami, Kanade and Mizuki all came together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Yoisaki was there?
Wait, did you also say Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yoisaki offered an invitation because she knew Mizuki likes to make collages and alterations to clothing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You knew?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki shared some thoughts with me about our show idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our little twist elicited surprise, but the show proved enjoyable in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, Mizuki was in the audience while Mochizuki and Yoisaki played the main characters.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting... I can kind of see Mochizuki performing in a show, but not Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Honami and Kanade were both startled in the beginning, but they worked really hard together to ring the bell♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, you just want Kanade to have fun today...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that was the plan.
But it sort of ended up having the opposite effect.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize it would be this difficult...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm really glad Honami and Kanade had so much fun in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just remembered the way they smiled at the end, and I'm feeling happy all over again♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It wasn't just Honami and the others!
Our show made so many people smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you guys so much for your advice!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, enough chatter for now.
I believe it's about time we began practicing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks for listening!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for telling us what happened. I've been meaning to ask you about it for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah.
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, translate the following sentences...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Okay, got it☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Tomorrow, I need to remember to go shopping.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And for this one...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “I remember lending my little sister my house keys yesterday.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We just did both of those in class♪
That was a piece of cake☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sis...?
Yeah, come in!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Also, welcome home!
Are you done with classes already?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes, because one lecture got canceled.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I decided to relax at home for a change and heard that you were doing your homework.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I've prepared some snacks for you as a little reward. Would you like to take a break and have some with me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Snacks! Yes!
It's officially breaktime!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll get the table ready.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! All these bits of fruit are so colorful and pretty! What is this stuff?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It's called yogurt bark.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You make it by mixing yogurt with honey and throwing in whatever fruits you like. It hardens into this after you freeze it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's rock solid!
That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know. It's actually very easy to make, so why don't we do it together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, shall we start?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's dig in♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mmm☆ It's so nice and cool!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: The honey has this gentle sweetness to it, and it goes so well with the fruits and yogurt because they're a little tart! The Chef really outdid himself this time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, he did♪ Getting to have a treat that's so yummy and delicious in my own house makes me so happy♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But still, there are just some sweets you can only enjoy at a cafe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is there somewhere you want to go, Sis?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: The truth is, I've been wondering about this parfait some of my friends told me about. Here's a picture.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-What?! This parfait...
It's so big!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Isn't it? Apparently it's called the “Mount Everest strawberry parfait”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That's such a cool name!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
It looks like it lives up to its name, right?
I'm thinking about going out to try it sometime soon, but...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: If you're not busy with a show or practice, Emu, would you like to join me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: At the same time, Sis, you don't have to wait for me. You'd have no problem finishing this on your own.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know, but I'd rather have someone to enjoy this with. Also, I want to go with you since it's been a little while since we last went out together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Hehe. That makes me so happy. I've been wanting to go out somewhere with you too☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, that's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: We'll be going to a cafe called... Let's see... I believe it's called “carino/carina”. I'll be sure to find exactly where it is!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, that name sounds familiar...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sis, can I see that picture again?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Sure, but that one was only of the parfait. This one might be better. Here, it shows more of the cafe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I knew it...!
This is where Saki and Minori work!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Your friends from school?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I've been there before, so I know exactly where it is!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You do? Then, if you don't mind showing me the way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope they have a shift scheduled when we go.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I hope so too! If it isn't too much of a bother, I'd love to meet them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to go.
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna try something new next time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See you later, Mizuki!
Thanks for the yummy parfaits!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
See you!
I'm glad you enjoyed everything!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. That parfait ended up being very good.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: And I'm glad your friends were also there, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too. And not just Saki.
I was really surprised to see Mizuki there♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You and Mizuki became friends recently, yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Rui and Mizuki go way back.
Mizuki's even seen a few of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We got to know each other at the Phoenix Bridal Fair, and we've been friends ever since.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
I see.
It's wonderful to hear that you made a new friend.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, we didn't actually decide what we were going to do after visiting the cafe. Is there anywhere you'd like to go, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
We went shopping before going to the cafe, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go where you wanna go, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know where we can go! It's been so long since we last went together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Where?
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whee! It's going so fast☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Emu, look! Here comes the loop-the-loop!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been far too long. That was a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Okay, what should we go on next?

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Grandma, Grandpa, that one!
I wanna go on the fish coaster next!

rows.Speaker: Grandfather
rows.Line:
Ah, the fish coaster.
That takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Me too. Remember how that was the only thing you ever wanted to go on, son?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: That's because I thought the fish were so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Even now, you always seem more excited about going on it than your own child.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Wow, three generations all at once...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Mommy! Mommy!
I also really love the fish coaster!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: That's why I'm gonna bring my kids here when I'm all grown up!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I'll be looking forward to that day.

rows.Speaker: Grandparents
rows.Line:
Hahaha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope that little boy doesn't forget what he just said and brings his own children here in the future.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
I can't say for sure that he will...
But how incredible would that be if he did?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means I need to keep doing what we can to make sure Phoenix Wonderland never ever loses its magic.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You really love this park, don't you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course I do!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna do everything I can to make sure Phoenix Wonderland keeps putting smiles on everybody's faces forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sis...?
Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It's just... I really want to hug you right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
Or we can rub our cheeks together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! Sis, that tickles!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: The sun's already setting.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Time sure does fly when you're having fun. I sort of don't want this day to end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
This day is ending, but it's also the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's something I heard from someone♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Dusk is when you should start preparing for tomorrow's fun!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so beautiful...
I really like how this person thinks.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Then, let's go home, have dinner and take a nice, hot bath! For tomorrow's fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Sis! I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Emu!
You're back a little later than usual.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! There was somewhere I wanted to go with Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, that reminds me.
Keisuke and Shosuke told you about what Grandpa said to them, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup...!
So, Sis...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna visit lots and lots of places, and learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: With Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I'm sorry for everything that you had to go through.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
So you were worried about me too.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Of course I was worried. We're family.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, is there anything else that's on your mind? Anything you'd like to say? Please feel free to tell me everything.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Because I want you to be the happiest person in the world.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm okay...!
I've gotten everything off my chest.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. So much weight's been lifted off of me that I can't help but tear up again...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Just let it all out.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, your eyes are all red.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. So are yours, Sis. You look like a bunny now.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. We should cool off our faces before they start swelling too much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, Sis...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you already know what was going through my mind?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I did...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Keisuke and Shosuke mentioned it to me before. How Tsukasa and the others had started to hope for more opportunities to hone their craft outside Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: And how you might decide to stay behind to protect the park...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They did...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, does that mean Mom and Dad also...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Yes, they know as well.
We had a meeting as a family to discuss that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! But I thought they were both traveling overseas on business right now!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. That's where the tool of our age comes in! The internet!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Mom became so worried after we told her what was going on that she began shuffling her schedule around just to come back to Japan to see you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Oh no... Do you think she's still worried?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: She should be fine. Keisuke and Shosuke said they'd let her know once you made your decision.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I'm sure she's feeling much better right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still, I didn't realize just how much trouble I was causing you guys...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, don't say that.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You're the baby in the family, so you should be making big wishes whenever you can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Maid
rows.Line: Ms. Emu, I have your mother on the phone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Mom?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. You should go.
I'm sure there's lots of things you'd like to tell her about.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I'm gonna tell her all about what's happened☆
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If I could collapse on my bed right now, I'd probably fall asleep right away...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
I bet our dreams would be really amazing since we'd be sleeping like babies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did spend the last two months preparing for our final show at a furious pace.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I might fall asleep as I eat if I'm not careful.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As you eat? You shouldn't literally act like a baby.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, it's safer than falling asleep while taking a bath. Others may not immediately realize if something were to go wrong.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, what's with that grin?! Stop trying to scare us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh, Rui... Now I'm fully awake...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: No, it's not!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I get to keep being with them...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I get to keep doing shows as a member of Wonderlands×Showtime...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. That makes me so happy...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...? There's a ton of people gathered around the main gate!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right... But it's past closing. All the visitors should've left by now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's see what's going on☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow...! So many of the cast members are here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What's going on...?!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
It's Wonderlands×Showtime! They're here!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Perfect! We've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? For us...?
That's right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Sakurako Seiryuin?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I suppose it's going to be quite some time before I hear you shout my name like this again...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I went around to suggest we see you off on your journey, and basically everyone decided to show up.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Take it as proof that my word carries some weight around here.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But we all owe you so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Thank you for saving Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: If you hadn't acted, who knows what would've become of our stage...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: You guys are the reason why the Phoenix Wonderland we all know and love is still the way it is!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: All of you reminded us what really matters most. That gave us the courage to stand back up and fight!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: So, from the bottom of our hearts...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Thank you!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: And!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako & Cast
rows.Line: Break a leg out there!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
And this park is in good hands.
We're going to keep protecting it and make it an even happier place than before.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: We won't let you down this time, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah! So don't worry about us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna see a lot of new things, learn as much as I can, grow like crazy and come back here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! Fireworks?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes. They're a special farewell gift from a very special guest.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Honestly, how long do you plan on hiding back there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Mascot!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I still remember the day I stood on stage with you for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Not one visitor was in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: The voices of those on the rides and attractions echoed through whenever you paused between lines.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Our second and third days were also... No, not just then. That situation continued for a very long time...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: But things are different now.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: You and your troupe have helped return the Wonder Stage to its former glory. It is once again a place where people come to see shows, feel genuine excitement and go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Your ability to dream has helped you meet countless new people and made your own dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I doubt I'm ever going to forget seeing all of those smiles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Mascot...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I believe your ability to dream will bring smiles to people all around the world.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Just as your grandfather once did.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line:
So, please...
Go. Do not worry about us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Mascot...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me all those times! And thank you for performing on stage with me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm standing here today because of you! I never would've been able to make it this far without you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you! Thank you so so much...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're the bestest friend ever...!!!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: You give me far too much credit...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: We likely won't be performing on stage together in the future, but I will still be at your service.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: So, please ask me if you're ever in need of assistance. I shall come to your aid whether you're on the other side of the world or in outer space.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'll be sure to let you know then, Mr. Mascot!
The day before Emu's birthday
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh. I couldn't help but drop by.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We won't be doing any shows here at the Wonder Stage for a while...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we're going to learn and experience everything we can and come back with a bang!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright☆
Motivation, check! Energy, check! I'm gonna do my best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Was someone here just now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An envelope! I'm pretty sure it wasn't there before...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, there's something written on the back...!

rows.Speaker: Mysterious Message
rows.Line:
“Open this on your birthday, when you're in a pinch.
K.S.H.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On my birthday? When I'm in a pinch?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: K.S.H. is probably the sender's name. I wonder who it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh well, that's for tomorrow☆
The letter said to open it on my birthday anyways!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

Fish?!

rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mhm!
I could keep eating these forever...!

rows.Line:
Mmm... Mmm?!
Hmmm...

I know the feeling...

The fish sausages!

rows.Line: One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Amazing, Emu!
This is a huge discovery that needs to get passed down to future generations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm really glad I had you at home, fish sausages!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think I'll have one more...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want another too!

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's a great idea...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, are you a genius...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Line: Backpack, backpack, backy-backpack! It's a fun, fun, fun, fun, new term♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Another happy day of school!
I'm up to 1,000 friends now♪

rows.Line:
Morning, Emu!
You sound super wonderhoy again today!

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You saying wonderhoy puts such a big smile on my face☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heehee!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since we ran into each other, let's head to the classroom together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's GO GO☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!

rows.Line: But I was able to make a bunch of new friends, so every day is super exciting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean!

rows.Line: Yesterday morning, I accidentally walked into my old classroom and the first-years all looked so confused. It was really embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha. I bet you were as surprised as the first-years!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But there's no need for you to worry today! We're heading straight to Class 2-B and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
Isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! Emu, this is the first-year hallway! It's happening all over again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry...
I guess my body's still not used to things either...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It takes time to adjust, huh? Anyway, let's hurry over to the second-year hallway!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know, this might sound silly, but it feels so different here... Changing classes was one thing, but there's a lot to get used to this term...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh!
That reminds me! I think we're supposed to pick committees today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I finally get to become that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. So you really are going to volunteer for that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how the class will turn out if you do manage to get chosen! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there's the bell!
We gotta get to class now!

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(This is it!
My chance has finally come.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: First, class representative—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me!
I'd like to do that!
During break

rows.Line: I didn't realize you were that set on becoming the class representative, Otori...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I was surprised too. I thought you were gonna join the planning committee for the Sports Festival since you worked so hard on it last year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I thought about that too!
But the other day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shosuke!
Which committee do you think I should be on this year?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Huh?
Just join whichever one you like. You don't have to ask me every time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I can't decide!
Doing the lunchtime program for the broadcasting committee sounds really fun, but I also wanna try taking care of the rabbits for the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...!
What if I made my own committee?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll call it the “wonderhoy committee!”
We'll put on shows at school and make everyone smile! I'll ask the teachers about it and...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
No, anything but that!
That'll get you in trouble and your school would try to set up a meeting with us!
Then, why not become the class representative?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Emu? As class representative?
Are you trying to cause total chaos..?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I've never really thought about that before...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The class representative holds the important role of guiding the class.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They must consider the differing opinions of their thirty or so classmates to come up with the perfect plan that keeps the class running in an orderly fashion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
That means...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
It is the perfect job for those who are “destined to lead”.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: If you truly wish to carry Phoenix Wonderland into the future, then wouldn't you say this is a great place to start?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to become the class representative.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I never would've guessed...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was completely under the impression that you were doing this to satisfy your curiosity...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I think your motivation qualifies you for the job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's gonna be a blast with you representing us, Otori. I'm pretty excited.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna do my very best to make our class as fun and smile-filled as I can!
Diner

rows.Line:
What?!
Emu, you became a class representative?!

rows.Line: Yeah, I did!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna do everything I can to fill my class with as many smiles as I can♪

Emu as a class representative...

rows.Line:
Does it sound fun...?

Emu could actually excel at leading the class in an innovative way.

rows.Line: You really think so?!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yes, that's definitely in the top three for toughest conflicts that I had to resolve as a class representative.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. I forgot that you were a class representative until not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Line:
No!

rows.Line:
A hall monitor?!
You?!

rows.Line: Haha. It's just one surprise after another for you today, Nene!

rows.Line:
Of course I'm surprised.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, how were your classes okay with either of those things?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well...

rows.Line:
Very true.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!

rows.Line:
Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, there are some seeds that I planted that have yet to sprout.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It didn't feel right for me to leave before they had the chance to grow into flowers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to care for plants that much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You don't even eat your veggies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I said the same thing to him just the other day.

rows.Line: Anyway, let's leave it at that. I'm glad to hear that we all joined committees we can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Throw any questions you have my way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly, I'm not sure if you really wanna follow his example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But as far as I could tell, his classmates seemed to hold him in very high regard.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna do my best to become a reliable class rep just like Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Class 2-B's gonna be so wonderhoy and full of smiles! I'll work hard to make this the most fun year ever☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Break a leg.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's our Emu for you.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: To be fair, you really do love taiyaki that much.

rows.Line: Really? They tasted that good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I think those taiyaki tasted so good!

rows.Line: You're blowing things out of proportion again.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We should take the opportunity to spend more time together as a family.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Including Mom and Dad?
Woohoo! I can't wait♪

rows.Line:
Shunmeiza...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, really?!

rows.Line: It was a story set in the modern day about a father and child learning to understand one another after not being able to for so long...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Line: I'm sure they won't be doing that either.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Which may mean that they have everyone work on having solid fundamentals.

rows.Line: Oh, you mean the things that are absolutely necessary for putting on good shows!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, so you'll get to learn about what goes on behind the scenes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Line: Rui was talking about how the people working behind the scenes play an important role in putting smiles on the faces of everyone involved in a show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna ask them lots and lots of questions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I wanna do everything I can to make sure all those who love Phoenix Wonderland also smile☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm gonna make that happen by learning as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Just don't cause them too much trouble, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Line: Hold on, Emu... Aren't you supposed to be meeting everyone really early tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, good night, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Okay, night...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Never a dull moment, huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. We wouldn't have her any other way.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But we should look forward to seeing how our little sister grows.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: So, we should focus on seeing as many exhibits as we can from the setting of the play.

rows.Speaker: Emu

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is so cool... It's like we've gone back in time.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yeah! Pardon us!

rows.Line: Ready when you are, Tsukasa☆

rows.Line: “No good! I won't make the deadline at this rate! But my livelihood depends on it...”

rows.Line: “No, all this anxiety is just going to prevent me from coming up with good ideas. I should try to relax by having some tea...”

rows.Line: “Excuse me. Would you mind bringing some tea?”

rows.Line: “Right away, Sir!”

rows.Line: Oh geez... Cut it out, don't you realize that other people are also here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
