rows.Line:
What a marvelous sight...!
Toys covering every inch of space!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
What are these ones...? Oh, they're all tin robots.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... So many. And they all have the same, bland look on their faces.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bland? I think they're all really cute.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, look! If you wind this one up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! It can walk?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... More like waddle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I find tin toys fascinating because of how they can move in a variety of ways despite their simple designs.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You look like you're having a lot of fun, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Find something interesting, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So... I just noticed all these funny-looking signs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Funny-looking?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. I can read each letter, but I don't get what they mean.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like that one! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Maerc Eci”? Is that what it says?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I believe that one's for ice cream.
Back then, they sometimes used to write Japanese to be read from right to left.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-This also news to me.
I was wondering what all these strange words meant...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. We're learning so many new things! This is so much fun☆ Oh, let's try going over there next!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Emu, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
That was a lot of fun! We got to see so much☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was nice how each exhibit was set up with an interactive element so that visitors get an immersive experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it was! I loved trying on all those Showa outfits♪ And they had sooo many, so choosing which ones to wear was also super fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That hat and one-piece dress looked really good on you. I'll send you that picture a little later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that outfit I picked out for you, Tsukasa. Wasn't it spectacular?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Spectacular? Hardly...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, was it not to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You made me dress up as a greengrocer! What does that have to do with the character I'll be playing?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it suited you really well.
You looked like the real thing when we took that picture of you at the vegetable stand exhibit...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's right! You looked really good with a headband on♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, I'm supposed to be playing a magazine editor!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, keep your voice down.
This is so embarrassing... Everyone's looking at us now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Why am I the one being chastised...?! If anything, that should be Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, the next time we come here, I'm going to pick out a ridiculous outfit for you to wear! Call it payback!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I agree with Tsukasa. We should totally come here again sometime since we didn't have time to see everything!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'd also like to come back.
We really only went around to the exhibits from the years that our show's set in.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They apparently have two more halls...
It'll be exciting to see how they differ from what we saw today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! So, to make sure that we come back here smiling, we'll need to give this show everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! We get to come back♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Let's do our absolute best during our next practice!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm super duper excited☆
Doop dee doo♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You seem even more energetic than usual today, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's understandable.
After all, today is the first day of our shows collaborating with Puroland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We're gonna put on a special wonderhoy performance with our buddies at Puroland!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's right. They taught us a lot of stuff during our rehearsals, so we've gotta make sure we put it into practice for the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, yup! It's time to deliver a whole lotta smiles to the guests at Puroland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Off we gooo☆
Wisdom Tree Stage

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Do you all know about Dream Fairies?
These adorable spirits are born from humans' dreams and support them in making them come true.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Oh, look over there!
It seems the dreams you all hold have drawn a pair of Dream Fairies here to visit.”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy A
rows.Line: “Hello, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy B
rows.Line: “Wow, you're all so full of energy! I'll bet you each have wonderful dreams!”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy A
rows.Line: “Yeah! We just have to support these guys!”

rows.Speaker: Dream Knight
rows.Line:
“Forgive my intrusion.
There have been sightings of a Nightmare Fairy in the area. Have you seen them?”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy A
rows.Line: “A Nightmare Fairy?”

rows.Speaker: Dream Knight
rows.Line: “Yes. A loathsome creature that stomps out humans' dreams. Let me know if you find them, and I, the Dream Knight, will defeat them!”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy A
rows.Line:
“Stomping out dreams? That's so mean!
Why would they do that...?”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy B
rows.Line:
“There's no use thinking about that.
Let's just focus on supporting the dreams of everyone here!”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy A
rows.Line: “Yeah! Hey everyone, what kind of dreams do you have? Who would like to share?”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
I do!
Me! Me!

rows.Speaker: Nightmare Fairy
rows.Line: “Please pick me. I'd love to tell you my dream.”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy B
rows.Line: “Huh? You're...”

rows.Speaker: Nightmare Fairy
rows.Line:
“Hehe, I am the Nightmare Fairy!
And I am here to stomp out the dreams of all these children!”
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. We left the guests smiling so much♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. They responded well to our call-outs, so it made for a good interactive show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Their cheering was really intense at the part when the Dream Knight drew energy from everyone's dreams to defeat the Nightmare Fairy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it made me delighted to be defeated.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But, we wouldn't have been so successful had it not been for everything we learned in rehearsals about drawing in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We gotta learn even more during the rest of our performances, and that way we can bring even more smiles to everyone watching!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, look at that. The show that our co-stars recommended to us is about to start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Hehehe, I can't wait to see Cinnamon's show♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's about Cinnamon making food for his friends to fulfill his dream of becoming a restaurant chef, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a different kind of show from the one we're appearing in, so I'm sure we'll have much to learn from it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting...!

rows.Speaker: Keroppi
rows.Line: “Aww, I'm hungry.”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “Hello, Keroppi. If you're hungry, how about I cook you something?”

rows.Speaker: Keroppi
rows.Line: “Oh, really?”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “Yes. It's my dream to become a restaurant chef, so I want to get some practice.”

rows.Speaker: Keroppi
rows.Line: “I see! Then can you make me some rice balls with looots of tasty filling?”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line:
“Leave it to me♪
Squeezy squeezy, rolly rolly...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa... Cinnamon's working so hard to make those rice balls!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: His ears are so floppy and fluffy and cute! Right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... You're right. I kinda want to touch them.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “All done♪ Bon appetit, Keroppi.”

rows.Speaker: Keroppi
rows.Line:
“Don't mind if I do!
Om nom... Oh, it's so good!”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “Hehe, I'm glad you like it.”

rows.Speaker: U・SA・HA・NA
rows.Line:
“Hey, Cinnamon.
I want an orange sherbet.”

rows.Speaker: Hangyodon
rows.Line: “I want chilled noodles!”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “Okie dokie! I'll make them one at a time, so can you guys form a line?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He looks like a fish, but he likes chilled noodles?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you mean Hangyodon? Apparently, he's not a fish but a merman, so his taste in food is probably similar to a human's.

rows.Speaker: Dwarf
rows.Line: “Hmm... It is delicious, but I wanted 'Mom's pancakes', and this doesn't quite taste like that...”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “I see... Then, let me try again. Can you tell me how it was different from what you wanted?”

rows.Speaker: Dwarf
rows.Line: “Huh? But these pancakes are yummy. They taste just fine.”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “But my dream is to become a restaurant chef and make everyone happy.”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “So I'm gonna keep trying until my pancakes make you smile from the bottom of your heart!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So Cinnamon is trying really hard to make people smile too...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can do it, Cinnamon!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was a super wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It truly was. I teared up during the scene when Cinnamon completed the dwarf's ideal pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It gave me extra motivation to make someone else smile like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. Let's do our best tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Cinnamon worked really hard to make everyone smile.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've gotta do the same...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, guys. Before we go home, do you wanna look around Puroland a little?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna know what sorta stuff they do to make their guests smile!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, that's fine by me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We could even go on the rides while we're here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Then our Puroland Smile Survey Grand Adventure begins! Let's go☆
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm glad we made so many people smile with our Puroland collaboration show☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We also got to have so much fun exploring Puroland and learning a whole bunch of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And after that...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “But my dream is to become a restaurant chef and make everyone happy.”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: “So I'm gonna keep trying until my pancakes make you smile from the bottom of your heart!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It made me happy to know Cinnamon is also working hard to make people smile.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'm gonna work hard too to bring smiles to people around the world! I can do this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? My phone just flashed...
What could that be?
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... I thought it was Miku and everyone calling me over, but no one's around.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! Something flashed again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What was that?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What is this place?
I get the feeling I've been here before...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
It looks just like Puroland!
Heeey! Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! You guys are here too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I was just in my room when my phone flashed suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's that up there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's something floating in the sky. It's getting closer...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, is that—

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cinnamon?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Hellooo!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line:
Oh, it's not just us!
Other friends are here too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on...?!
How is Cinnamon here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: C-C-Calm down Nene! In SEKAI, this sort of thing is a regular, everyday, run-of-the-mill occurrence!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm... What would be more fun?
I could join the panic and say, “You're the one who should calm down, Tsukasa,” or I could make a deadpan quip like, “'Regular, everyday, run of the mill' is redundant, Tsukasa.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ooh, let's all panic! That sounds fun!
What do you think, Cinnamon?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hm, me? I think...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey! Don't just carry on talking as if this is an ordinary conversation!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How are you here?
What is this place...?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hmm, I also just appeared here somehow. But, I do know a little about this place.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Apparently, it's a “SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling”, and it was born from people thinking, “Puroland was so fun!” and “I wanna go back again!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... In that case, it's no surprise to see Cinnamon descend from the skies.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I think it's more than a little surprising...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm riding a cloud now, but usually I flap my ears to fly!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That's so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They have a quite different shape than a bird's wings... Hehe, how intriguing.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Do you guys wanna touch my ears?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: May I? Then don't mind if I do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're...even fluffier than I imagined!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, wow!
Can I touch them too, Cinnamon?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, they're all fluffy and fuzzy...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, they really are...
Nene, why don't you try too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa... It's true. So fluffy...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hehehe, that kinda tickles.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hey, can I hear about you guys now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
My apologies! We still haven't introduced ourselves. We are...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Oh, so you're learning about putting on shows so you can put smiles on lots of people's faces?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: I also put on shows at Puro Village sometimes myself.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! We saw one of them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When I saw you working so hard to make your dream come true, it inspired me to work hard too!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line:
You really mean that?
Hehehe, I'm happy to hear that♪

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hey, you all did a show at Puroland too, right? I wish I could watch it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It would be our pleasure to perform it for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll do our best to make you smile too, Cinnamon☆

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's an interactive show, so we'd love it if you could participate and make it even more fun.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Okay, you can count on me.

rows.Speaker: Nightmare Fairy
rows.Line:
“Dreams? Pathetic.
My Nightmare Wand will show you cold, hard reality! Behold!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Wait, what...?
I was working so hard to become an international songstress...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“All I can think about is failure...
Maybe it is an impossible dream...”

rows.Speaker: Dream Knight
rows.Line: “Not so fast, you nasty Nightmare Fairy! It is anything but pathetic to have a dream!”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy
rows.Line: “That's right! It's hard to make a dream come true, and the road is never easy...”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy
rows.Line: “But if you can dream, you can face anything, even nightmarish reality!”

rows.Speaker: Dream Fairy
rows.Line: “Isn't that right, everyone?!”

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Sometimes things don't go my way and leave me feeling blue...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: But when I see people enjoying my cooking and smiling, it makes me want to dream bigger and make even more people smile.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: And when I dream even bigger, I can try my hardest to overcome all the challenges I face.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Cinnamon...

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: And that's why I think, if I just cherish my dream, I can one day become a chef who'll bring happiness to everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Yes... That's right. I won't give up either. I already made up my mind to sing all over the world!”

rows.Speaker: Nightmare Fairy
rows.Line: “What is this...?”

rows.Speaker: Dream Knight
rows.Line: “With such powerful dreams concentrated in one place, we might just be able to destroy the Nightmare Wand.”

rows.Speaker: Dream Knight
rows.Line: “Prepare yourself, Nightmare Fairy!”

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone!
It was a wonderful show♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. I'm glad you enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it wouldn't have been such a wonderhoy show without you helping us put it together!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Wonderhoy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, so like, “wonderhoy” is like our magic word to make people smile☆

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Oh, I see. What a wonderful word!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Hey, can we all say wonderhoy together?

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: If we do, I have a feeling that we'll always be connected through our hope to make people smile♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! I wanna say it with you too, Cinnamon!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, Emu, cue us in please!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On three! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... We've got plenty of drinks and snacks...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! I think we're all set to go☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what Mr. Ohara's films are like! I'm really looking forward to the story!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope the others get here soon♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I think that's them...!
Welcome, everyoooone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come on in☆ I've been waiting for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Waiting for us to get here is great and all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What in the world is this plaaaaaaaaace?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't “huh” me!
Answer me! What is the meaning of this place...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It has a giant screen covering the whole wall and a sound system I've never seen anywhere else! Also, these chairs are far too luxurious for their own good...!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's like a full-blown movie theater!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We always come here to watch movies and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Always...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Emu's house never ceases to amaze.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Guys, look! I've got snacks and drinks for all of us☆ We can have these while we watch♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, right...
I was so staggered that I forgot why we're all gathered here today...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're watching “The Spring Lantern”, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
The protagonist, Mabuchi, saw his mother arrested when he was little, and has been labeled the son of a criminal ever since...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The story centers around him as an adult discovering that his mother may have been the victim of a miscarriage of justice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have to say...
That sounds like a bleak story...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is. However, very unlike Mr. Ohara's other works, this one involves a few action scenes... I have a feeling we'll all enjoy watching it together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Action does sound like fun!
Then, let's start watching☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Not only did his neighbors talk about him behind his back, but everyone at school treated him like dirt... I can't imagine how he must've felt while growing up...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... Talk about a sad childhood...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait... Not only did this man say something foreboding a minute ago, but he also seems very familiar with Mabuchi's mother...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's it! This man's the real culprit!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I seriously doubt this one's that simple...

rows.Speaker: Mabuchi
rows.Line: <I don't plan on ever forgiving you. But...I still appreciate what you did. I probably wouldn't have made it this far on my own.>

rows.Speaker: Mabuchi
rows.Line: <I can finally start living a normal life.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, we're at the credits...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's over...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't believe it was actually that person...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I got fooled too!
I completely thought it was his neighbor Sasano the entire time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you two went straight for the bait.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The man you thought was behind it all ended up being the protagonist's most important friend, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... My deduction skills still need work...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, this film really delivered in terms of doing an excellent job of presenting each character's emotions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and the whole cast was amazing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I couldn't help but side with the protagonist. I found myself rooting him on as he went after the real suspect...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, my heart really went out to him...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They did a magnificent job of making use of each actor's talents and skills.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The way you can lead the viewer's eye with good camerawork or cleverly use certain shots to present how a character's feeling... The screen gives you access to so many techniques.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and despite it being a bit of a sad story, it was still very good. I think we all learned a lot from it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, didn't Rin say that she wanted to watch a film with us?

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “No! You aren't going to catch me so easily!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Huh...?! She's coming this way!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Stop right there, thief! Did you really think you'd get away with this?”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Eep...!
Someone's coming from behind!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“No, you're that detective!
N-Not good!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Heh. End of the line!
You're under arrest!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The life of a criminal is seldom a long one. Now, it's time for you to face the music!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Nooo!
A pincer move! I'm trapped!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Haha. She's starting to panic!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I've never seen people do a skit so up close like this before. This is really fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
Th-There's nothing I can do!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, the moral of the story is that you need to be very careful with your belongings!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you happen to witness a theft in progress, be sure to ask a nearby ronin or detective wearing a staff badge for help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We promise to continue doing our best to keep you smiling and laughing, so please try to stay positive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, we hope you enjoy the rest of your time here at Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
We did that skit completely on the fly, but everyone seemed to really enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I really hope it helps keep their spirits up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I think it's already having a positive effect. Look...!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: That was meant to be a warning about all the thefts we've been hearing about, right?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: I think so. But I ended up laughing for most of it.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Me too. And the staff will help us if anything does happen, so let's just try to have fun...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Things are just so much better when everyone's smiling like this...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I mean, this park's meant to be a place where they get to have fun.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep up the momentum and keep doing more of these skits!!!
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I feel terrible about having our farewell party here since it's supposed to be a special occasion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, that's not a problem!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It isn't your fault that the place you usually go to was closed due to an emergency... We're just glad to be here!

rows.Line: Plus, we owe you and your troupe so much for letting us train here! This place has a special place in our hearts now!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Thank you for saying that.

rows.Line: Alright, then...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Cheeers!
Cheers!

rows.Line: On top of everything we got from the deli, we splurged on pizza and sushi! Feel free to have as much as you like!

rows.Line:
Yay, pizza♪
Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll have some as well! Ow, hot!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Slow down, you two. That pizza's still scalding hot.

rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna have some of this sushi next☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you've already finished eating that pizza?! But it's molten hot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so good that I had to gobble it up whole♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew... I'm stuffed...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
I'm glad you enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you!

rows.Line: But you two still seem hungry, Otori, Tenma...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I like your spirit!

rows.Line: But we really need to thank you again for throwing us a farewell party like this.

rows.Line: We learned a lot from all of you. We owe you a great debt.

rows.Line:
No, we should also be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And we certainly wouldn't have been able to catch the thief that was terrorizing Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: He's right. We honestly couldn't believe it when we saw you up on top of that fire tower, Otori.

rows.Line: Wait, you saw me?!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Just when we were thinking that it'd be nice to have an eye in the sky, we noticed you up there...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That was a great idea!
We wouldn't have been able to catch that thief without your plan, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I was able to help♪

rows.Line: But I didn't come up with that idea! A friend of mine did! I'll make sure to thank her the next chance I get!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
I see!
Still, your vision must be really good since you were able to pick out individual people from that high up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is incredible...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Right, I was also amazed by that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. My vision's always been super good!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: You're also really athletic, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: I know, right?! We thought we'd gotten used to that sort of thing looking at our leader, but you just kept finding new ways to surprise us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Emu's always surprising us as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. You're always somersaulting down from these tall trees!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And you dodged everyone's attacks with ease during our sword fighting practices. Plus, you're really fast.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Everyone's showering me with praise!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's more where that came from.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When we got stranded on that island, you were the first one to find us berries and bananas.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: S-Stranded...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah...!
Sounds like you all had yourselves an interesting adventure!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Shosuke told me a little about all of you, but you really are a fun bunch of kids.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I wish we could spend some more time together since it really felt like you were constantly surprising us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish we could stay longer too...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You had me on the edge of my seat every time I saw you play a character, Mr. Kijima...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now I really wanna learn how to put on those kinds of performances!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: As long as we all keep on acting, I'm sure we'll cross paths again someday.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, I'll be looking forward to the day we meet again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna practice lots and lots to make sure I blow you guys away the next time we meet!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Ah, we'll certainly be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(They're all so nice...
And I learned so much from them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to make the most of what they taught me!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because I wanna make as many people as I can smile from ear to ear!)

rows.Line:
Hi there!

rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!

Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Line: (Asahina and I brainstormed a lot together, but we couldn't come up with any ideas that felt just right...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Honami helped make our poster really amazing by drawing all those great pictures for us, so anyone who spots it should be able to see how fun it's gonna be...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What if they aren't...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What if they can't see how making everything nice and squeaky-clean by pulling out all the weeds would be fun and make them feel really happy...?)

rows.Line: Emu, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Sis?!
Come on in!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Sorry, I know it's late.
I just got back from that trip and brought back some souvenirs for you. Here you go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! It's one of those regionally-themed taiyaki keychains! I really love these☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks, Sis!
Hehe. I wonder what color the paste inside it is♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, what's that on your desk? A poster for something...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right...!
I'm doing some volunteer work as a class rep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm in the middle of trying to recruit more people to come pull weeds with me...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: And you're running into some trouble?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-H-H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was written all over your face.
You seemed a little down.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Also, pulling weeds is usually very hard work. People must be thinking that having to do it in the heat would be incredibly exhausting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I knew it...!
Another class rep in the year above me said the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, how have you been trying to recruit people?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I've been putting up posters like this one... And talking to anyone who seems interested!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whenever someone stops in front of one of our posters, I fly over towards them and tell them about how fun it's gonna be☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I see. You're trying to invite individual people who spot your posters...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: This is just my humble opinion, but I feel that it'd be better to try reaching out to a large group of them all at once.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All at once?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes. For example, you could ask the teachers to see if they'll let you make an announcement in the morning or before school gets out.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know it's easier to get your message across to someone when you talk to them one-on-one, but it's also very time-consuming, no?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Speaking to multiple people all at once should save you quite a lot of time. Plus, any who decide to sign up may try to convince their friends to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I never would've thought of that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Which means I've still got a lot to learn...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: There are many ways to go about an issue like this. And what I just said isn't necessarily the only solution.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: However, it's good that you're able to come up with so many ideas on your own. I'm sure you'll learn to see things from different angles as you keep gaining more and more experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay! I promise to keep trying...!
Thanks for the advice, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Do your best, class rep! I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna get lots and lots of people to volunteer to pull weeds with us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
